title: Operations and Reporting Coordinator
description:
Operations and Reporting Coordinator

Full-time, remote. Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm US Central (10:00pm to 7:00am Manila time from November to March; 9:00pm to 6:00am from March to November). Reports to Operations Lead.



ABOUT LUX & NYX

Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell across Shopify DTC, Amazon, Nordstrom, and Macy's, and through a corporate gifting channel. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu.



THE ROLE

You'll keep the back end of our business right: the numbers we d
 on, the products we list, and every order after the customer clicks Buy. You'll prepare our daily sales and ads reports, be our warehouse's main contact, answer our customers, and keep our listings and catalogs accurate on every channel. You'll work closely with Michelle, who leads operations, and take vendor follow-up and day-to-day execution off her plate.



This role is half care and half precision. You need to be warm with a customer and politely persistent with a vendor, and you need to refuse to upload, send or pay anything when a number doesn't match its source. The most valuable thing you do is catch the mistake before it goes live.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Reporting: prepare our daily sales report and marketing ads reports, check every number against its source, and flag anything that doesn't add up.

• Orders and the warehouse: keep orders moving across our store, Amazon and retail partners, be our warehouse's main contact, check the returns, files and invoices it sends us, and follow up with vendors until every issue is closed.

• Customer care and reviews: answer customers within one business day, warmly and in our brand voice, including refunds, returns and warranty claims, and look after our product reviews.

• Inventory and listings: keep stock files, product listings, our ESP and SAGE corporate gifting catalogs and approved promotions accurate on every channel, checked against our master sheet.

• Production support: get our weekly production meeting ready, and prepare purchase orders, packing lists and shipping documents from approved inputs.

• Returns and tickets: reconcile returns and refunds, and follow every open support ticket until it's fixed.

• Systems and SOPs: write down every step you own, keep our trackers current, help set up new sales channels, and run the automations we approve.



Not part of this role: pricing, budget and other financial decisions, paid ads management, forecasting, corporate gifting quotes and orders (another teammate owns those), running the warehouse floor, product design, and accounting.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• You stop rather than upload. If a count, price or SKU doesn't match its source, nothing goes live until it does. That's the number one thing.

• You can trace every number. Ask where a figure came from and you can show the source. You're comfortable with totals, per-unit costs and variances.

• You work it out yourself. AI can help you draft or double-check, but the thinking and the judgment are yours.

• 2+ years reconciling or reporting operational data: inventory, orders and invoices, e-commerce reporting, or marketplace operations.

• Hands-on e-commerce listing experience: Amazon flat files, retailer portals or Shopify product setup, including fixing rejected or suppressed listings.

• Customer care for an online brand: order questions, refunds, returns and warranty claims, written warmly and clearly.

• Strong spreadsheet skills: formulas, lookups and reconciliations.

• Clear, polished written English, and steady follow-through without anyone having to chase you.

• A builder: when something was never written down, you write it down and make it the standard.

• Here for the long haul: you want to own this work and get great at it.



A strong plus: Mirakl, ShipStation, ESP or SAGE catalogs, retailer vendor portals, EDI, packing lists and carton planning, or working day to day with a warehouse.



You don't need every box ticked. If you catch the mistake before it goes live and you can show where every number came from, we want to hear from you.



WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

• Every report goes out on time and matches its source.

• Customers hear back within one business day.

• Every listing and catalog matches our master sheet.

• Every open vendor issue and support ticket has a next step.

• Every recurring step is written down.



PAY AND BENEFITS

US$600 to $1,300 a month depending on experience, plus a performance bonus. Paid PTO. Health stipend. Weekly 1:1 with Michelle, async-first on Slack.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply right here on OnlineJobs.ph. Your application must do three things:



1. Start with the word TRACE.

2. Answer this in your own words: It's Monday, December 21. Tomorrow at 10:00am US Central you upload the Amazon available-to-sell file. Last Friday's inventory file shows 448 units of the Belt Bag in Black. On Saturday, 30 units shipped on a corporate order. Today's warehouse count shows 412 units. 12 customer returns arrived Friday and haven't been inspected yet. The warehouse is closed Thursday and Friday for Christmas. What number would you upload, what do you check before you do, who do you tell, and by when?

3. Include your resume, or a Google Drive link to it that opens.



Applications missing any of the three won't be reviewed. Those three steps are deliberate: they show us, before we ever meet, whether you read carefully and own the details.



NEXT STEPS

If you're shortlisted: a short form and a recorded video intro, then a paid skills test, then a call with our founder where you'll walk us through some of your answers. Then an offer.

title: Real Estate Video Editor | Small Teams Welcome
description:
ZABE Media is a growing real estate media company based in Austin, Texas. We're seeking an experienced video editor or small editing team for a long-term partnership.



We prioritize exceptional video quality, consistency, reliable turnaround, and professional communication. Small teams with a dedicated primary editor and backup coverage are preferred.



THE OPPORTUNITY

- Recurring projects with flexible, per-video compensation.

- Videos include property walkthroughs, listing videos, social reels, drone videos, and agent-led content.

- Footage is primarily captured on iPhones, with additional drone and camera footage.

- Opportunities for increased production volume as we grow.



TARGET PRICING (USD)

- Property Walkthrough: $25

- Standard Listing (13 clips, 30 sec): $35

- Premium Listing (18 clips, 45 sec, drone/agent): $50

- Standard Extended (30 clips, 60 sec, drone): $50

- Premium Extended (40 clips, 90 sec, drone/agent): $75

- Drone Only (13 clips, 30 sec): $35



Prices include commercially licensed music, reasonable revisions, and final MP4 export. Rates are negotiable based on quality and reliability. Custom cinematic projects may be quoted separately.



EDITING REQUIREMENTS

- Smooth speed ramping, transitions, natural pacing, and strong shot selection.

- Professional color correction, stabilization, music synchronization, and audio balancing.

- Clean integration of interior, exterior, drone, and agent-led footage.

- Ability to edit horizontal and vertical videos.

- Internal QC to ensure consistent, client-ready results with minimal revisions.

- AI-assisted tools are welcome, but all videos require human review.



TURNAROUND & RELIABILITY

- Meet agreed deadlines based on project complexity.

- Provide prompt revisions during morning QC when needed.

- Accommodate fluctuating workloads and communicate potential delays.



TEAM EXPECTATIONS

Small teams are preferred, but individuals are welcome. Teams must have a designated primary editor and trained backup who meet the same quality standards. No reassignment without approval.



QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of professional video editing experience preferred.

- Proficiency in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar software.

- Experience with real estate walkthroughs, reels, drone, and agent-led videos.

- Reliable equipment, communication, and production capacity.

- U.S. real estate media experience is a plus.



HOW TO APPLY

Please provide:

1. Portfolio of walkthroughs, listing videos, reels, and drone edits.

2. Experience and editing software used.

3. Proposed pricing by video type and any additional fees.

4. Typical turnaround and daily/weekly capacity.

5. Individual or team structure, including backup arrangements.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid editing assessment using ZABE Media's footage. Finalists may participate in a paid production trial.



We're looking for a dependable editing partner who delivers exceptional results and can grow with ZABE Media.

title: Senior Content & Social Media Marketing Specialist (Video Editing, Meta Ads, Higgsfield)
description:
We're two growing businesses based in Sydney, Australia, looking for an experienced marketing specialist to join us long-term. If you know content, Meta ads and video editing inside out, we want to hear from you. This is a full-time role and we pay well.



ABOUT US

- Chandeliers To Die For: Sydney's luxury chandelier hire company for weddings and events, with 74K+ followers on Instagram.

- TAO (The Artificial Organisation): an AI company building custom AI systems for businesses.



PAY

- AUD $7 to $10 per hour (approx. PHP 294 to 420 per hour)

- Approx. AUD $1,150 to $1,650 per month (approx. PHP 48,000 to 69,000 per month)

- Final rate based on your experience and the quality of your work



THE ROLE

- Full-time, 38 hours per week, Monday to Friday

- Must work Sydney business hours (Sydney is 3 hours ahead of the Philippines)

- Fully remote, long-term position

- Philippines-based applicants only



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Content creation

- Write video scripts for Reels, TikToks and ads

- Storyboard videos before production

- Edit short-form videos in Adobe Premiere Pro

- Create AI video and imagery using Higgsfield

- Design social media graphics in Canva



Social media

- Post consistently on Instagram,
, TikTok and LinkedIn, including daily Stories

- Write captions and LinkedIn posts for the owner and both brands

- Engage with our audience through comments, DMs and community building

- Plan and manage a monthly content calendar



Meta advertising

- Plan, build and run Meta ad campaigns from start to finish

- Manage audiences, targeting, budgets, creatives and A/B testing

- Analyse campaign data in detail and optimise for results

- Send a weekly performance report



WHAT YOU NEED

- Minimum 5 years' experience in social media or content marketing

- Very strong video editing skills in Adobe Premiere Pro

- Hands-on experience with Higgsfield

- In-depth Meta Ads experience, with results you can show

- Proven scriptwriting and storyboarding skills

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Confident with Canva

- Reliable internet and backup power



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with luxury, wedding or events brands

- B2B or tech content experience on LinkedIn

- Familiarity with Asana



HOW TO APPLY

Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph and include:

1. Your CV

2. A link to your portfolio

3. 3 to 5 videos you've edited in Premiere Pro

4. A sample video script or storyboard

5. Examples of work you've created with Higgsfield

6. Social media accounts you've managed

7. One Meta ad campaign you've run, with its results

8. Your expected monthly salary



Start your application with the words "Sydney Specialist" so we know you've read this post. Applications without a portfolio won't be considered.



SELECTION PROCESS

Shortlisted applicants will complete a short unpaid test:

- Outline how you'd set up a Meta ads campaign for one of our businesses (objective, audience, budget and creatives)

- Edit a short video from footage we provide

- Design a social media post

- Write a short video script



Successful candidates will then start with a 2-week trial.



We look forward to seeing your work!

title: YouTube Video Editor for a Silicon Valley Real Estate Channel (about 4 videos a month, paid per video)
description:
I am a Realtor with Compass in Silicon Valley, California. I publish one video a week about buying and selling homes in Los Altos, Palo Alto, Mountain View and Los Altos Hills. The videos mix talking-head footage, walking neighborhood footage, charts and maps. The style is clean, clear and informative, not flashy.



What you will do for each video:

Cut 30 to 40 minutes of raw footage into an 8 to 12 minute video, following a written outline.

Remove mistakes, pauses and retakes, keeping the best take of each section.

Add burned-in captions and deliver a separate captions file.

Add simple graphics: lower thirds, chart callouts using the figures in the outline, and map highlights.

Clean up audio, apply basic color correction and add licensed background music.

Deliver an upload-ready file to a shared Google Drive folder.



Nice to have: experience making YouTube Shorts and thumbnails. These may be added later as paid extras.



Requirements:

A computer able to edit 4K footage smoothly.

Reliable internet of at least 25 Mbps upload and download, and a backup plan for power and internet outages.

Descript, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

Written English good enough to follow detailed notes.

First cut within 72 hours of receiving footage. One round of revisions within 48 hours.



How to apply:

Start your message with the word "Peninsula".

Send links to three videos you edited, ideally for real estate, finance or educational YouTube channels.

In two or three sentences, answer: what would you cut first to turn a 40-minute recording into a 10-minute video?

Tell me your time zone and your usual turnaround for a 10-minute video.

Must be reliable and readily available by phone, text, and company messaging software throughout your scheduled shift. This position requires frequent communication with the owner and timely responses to customer inquiries, new orders, and day-to-day operational needs. Prompt communication is essential.

Important



If you do not have reliable high-speed internet or a powerful computer capable of handling large media files, please do not apply. As part of our hiring process, we will require applicants to provide:



Computer specifications (CPU, RAM, storage, and graphics card if applicable)

Proof of internet speed (speed test screenshot)

Verification of your computer setup if requested

Compensation & Incentives



In addition to your salary, you'll have the opportunity to earn performance bonuses. Every new client you successfully bring in through the company's approved Instagram outreach system earns you a bonus on top of your regular pay.



If you're hardworking, reliable, honest, eager to grow, and ready to be part of a fast-paced team, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply today and tell us why you'd be a great fit for our team!

title: General Admin & Dispatch Virtual Assistant (Electrical, ServiceM8)
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with hands-on ServiceM8 scheduling and dispatch experience, clear spoken English and strong listening comprehension will be prioritised for this role.



An Australian electrical services business needs a full-time General Admin and Dispatch VA to run the front end of a busy, reactive service operation: phones, inbox and the ServiceM8 schedule for 5 to 7 crews. The challenge is keeping control of a moving machine, with emergency jobs, calls and
s landing at once and the schedule changing through the day, while building real rapport with customers and technicians from outside an open-plan office where decisions are often made out loud.



The non-negotiables are hands-on ServiceM8 scheduling and dispatch experience, clear spoken English with strong listening comprehension, and a task creator rather than a task ticker. Success looks like a VA who is on the phones within the first week in a supported role, independently managing the schedule within 30 to 60 days, keeping records accurate with nothing left half-finished, and freeing the business owner from having to think about the phones, inbox or schedule.



What You'll Own



Scheduling & Dispatch (ServiceM8)



Independently manage daily schedules for 5 to 7 crews

Allocate jobs based on tech capability, job duration, location and travel time

Create new jobs in ServiceM8 with complete, accurate job details

Update existing jobs as details, timing or status change

Slot urgent and emergency bookings into the day and rework the schedule around them

Process cancellations, delays and reschedules as they happen

Keep job statuses current so the office and field team work from the same information

Learn each technician's strengths and which apprentices they're paired with

Over time, make day-to-day scheduling calls without waiting for sign-off, note the reasoning, and flag anything genuinely unusual



Phones (approx. 15-25 inbound calls per day)



Day 1/Week 1 starting task: listen to previous recorded calls to learn the business, common issues, and how the team handles customers

Answer inbound calls from customers and capture job details: name, address, contact number, access notes and fault description

Repeat back key details before ending every call

Identify emergency calls (e.g. no power, safety risk) and get a tech allocated immediately

Log every call outcome in ServiceM8



Inbox Management (approx. 20
s per day)



Day 1/Week 1 starting task: review the last 2-3 months of
 history across the admin inbox and the ServiceM8 inbox to learn how things are typically resolved

Clear the inbox first thing every morning

Manage all inbound channels: the general admin inbox, the ServiceM8 inbox, and system notifications

Action routine
s directly (booking requests, job updates, follow-ups)

Flag anything needing input with a short summary and a suggested next step

Get the inbox to zero, or as close as possible, by end of day



Customer & Technician Communication



Keep customers informed of bookings, arrival times, delays and changes

Keep technicians informed of schedule changes, new urgent jobs and job details

Follow through on every outstanding enquiry until it's closed



Team & Management Liaison



Work with the management team to keep day-to-day operations running smoothly

Raise scheduling conflicts, capacity issues and recurring problems early

Share what you're seeing in the schedule: bottlenecks, repeat callbacks, overloaded crews

When phones and inbox are under control, find the next useful task



Systems & Documentation



Record every training and handover session

Write an SOP for each task after training, then walk it through with the team to confirm it's the right process

Track ad hoc tasks: job-related ones tied to the job in ServiceM8, everything else in Google Tasks



Daily Communication



Morning message with the day's priorities

End-of-day
 report: tasks completed, work in progress, and items needing review, approval or attention



Out of Scope (Current)



Pricing

Invoicing, quoting, bookkeeping and payroll (handled by the business's accountant)



What We're Looking For



Experience



Hands-on ServiceM8 experience, particularly scheduling and dispatch (top priority)

Prior admin or dispatch experience in a service-based trades business, with electrical a strong bonus

Experience in a reactive environment with emergency or same-day work is a nice-to-have



Communication Skills



Clear, confident spoken English for daily calls with Australian customers (top priority)

Strong listening comprehension, including with customers who have strong accents or speak English as a second language

A warm, relaxed phone manner that builds rapport with clients and the field team

Habit of repeating back details and asking again rather than guessing

Comfortable saying "I'll find out and call you back" and following through



Technical Proficiency



ServiceM8: scheduling, dispatch, job creation, inbox, tasks, phone system

Gmail and Google Workspace (Gmail, Tasks, Meet, Chat)

WhatsApp

Willing to learn tools like Fathom quickly

Comfortable working across two screens with the full schedule displayed



Organisational Skills



Keeps control of a schedule that changes through the day

Prioritises well when urgent jobs, calls and
s land at once

Strong attention to detail on bookings, job notes and admin

Closes the loop: accurate records, nothing half-finished, nothing left sitting



Non-Negotiables



Task creator, not a task ticker — finds the next useful thing to do once urgent work is done

Flags when there isn't enough on and suggests work rather than waiting

Documents processes without being prompted

Comfortable making scheduling decisions and owning the outcome

Easygoing and approachable, with a personality fit that suits a relaxed, direct team culture — avoid overly formal, passive or deferential candidates

Access to dual monitors (a local purchase can be arranged if needed)



Working Arrangements



Full-time role, replacing an existing in-house position

Hands-on training sequence: an intro day, a "sit with me" day watching live operations, listening to recorded calls and reviewing inbox history, then a supported period answering calls

Likely joins an all-day virtual office (Google Meet) given the business's open-plan, d
-out-loud culture



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of the front end of a busy, reactive service business

Real autonomy to make scheduling decisions, not just execute instructions

Join a tight-knit, easygoing team that values rapport and straight talk over formality

A business actively looking to build out VA support further, with room to grow into more as trust is established



How to Apply



To be considered, please complete this form and include a short video introduction — ideally one that clearly demonstrates spoken English and listening comprehension.

title: Sports Video Editor
description:
Job Description: Sports Video Editor

Canvas Management Group LLC · Nov 11, 2026 

About the role

Canvas Management Group is hiring a part-time Sports Video Editor to cut fast, high-impact highlight reels of our football and basketball clients. Canvas gives athletes the canvas for their vision, on and off the court, and video is how we show it to teams, scouts, brands and fans.

You will turn game film and raw footage into recruiting reels, social clips and short promos for Instagram, TikTok and X, often on same-day or next-day turnarounds.

Responsibilities

• Cut player highlight and recruiting reels from full-game film, fast, without sacrificing quality

• Pull and clip plays from Synergy Sports and PFF using filters for player, play type and situation

• Edit American football and basketball footage with clean pacing, music sync, spotlights, freeze frames and stat overlays

• Produce vertical (9:16) and horizontal (16:9) versions for Instagram, TikTok, X and scouting use

• Add branded graphics, lower thirds, player tags and captions to Canvas standards

• Turn around game-day and post-game clips within hours when needed

• Organize and archive footage, project files and exports by client and season

• Take feedback from the agency team and revise quickly

Required qualifications

• 2+ years editing sports video, with a portfolio of highlight or recruiting reels

• Proven speed: able to deliver a polished highlight reel within 24 hours of receiving film

• Hands-on experience with Synergy Sports (basketball) and PFF (football) to find, filter and export clips

• Has cut both American football and American basketball, and understands each sport well enough to pick the plays that sell a player (route running, blocks and coverage in football; scoring, defense and playmaking in basketball)

• Strong eye for pacing, music, transitions and storytelling

• Reliable with deadlines and responsive to feedback

Tools and equipment

Candidates must have their own editing setup:

• Professional editing software: Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve

• Motion graphics: After Effects or similar, for spotlights, player tracking and stat overlays

• Mobile and short-form tools such as CapCut for quick social cuts

• A computer powerful enough to edit HD and 4K game film smoothly

• Reliable high-speed internet for downloading film and delivering files

• Cloud storage or file transfer (Google Drive, Dropbox, Frame.io or similar)

Nice to have

• Experience with Hudl, Catapult or other film platforms

• Background working with a sports agency, college program, pro team or athlete brand

• Knowledge of what college coaches and pro scouts look for in a reel

• Social media know-how: trends, hooks, captions and what performs on each platform

title: AI Social Media, Influencer, Video & Paid Media Specialist
description:
Remote | Part-Time position with Full-Time Potential | US Business Hours



We're looking for a hands-on specialist who can take an idea all the way through concept, content, distribution and advertising to measurable results. **This is not a basic social media posting role.** You'll create and edit content yourself, work with influencers and UGC creators, appear on camera and LIVE, use modern AI creative tools, manage organic channels, run paid ads, repurpose long-form content, and analyze and improve performance.



You don't need to be an expert in every tool or platform listed. You do need strong marketing fundamentals, hands-on experience, excellent creative judgment and the ability to learn new AI and marketing tech quickly.



## The Role



You'll help own the full pipeline:

**Idea → Research → Script → Content Creation → AI Generation → Video/Editing → Clipping → Publishing → LIVE → Influencer/UGC Distribution → Paid Ads → Lead Generation →
/Follow-Up → Analytics → Optimization**



**Goals:**

- Build audiences and recognizable brands

- Increase engagement, reach and followers

- Generate qualified leads, booked appointments, sales and measurable revenue

- Find winning hooks, formats and creatives, and produce variations quickly

- Produce high-quality content at scale

- Turn winning organic and creator content into advertising

- Use influencers, creators and UGC strategically

- Keep testing, analyzing and improving



## Social Media & Content



**Platforms:** Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube & Shorts, LinkedIn, Snapchat, X/Twitter, Threads, plus Pinterest, Reddit/community platforms and emerging social or live-commerce platforms when relevant.



**Content types:** Reels, TikToks, Shorts, long-form video, static posts, carousels, Stories, educational, promotional, testimonials, case studies, founder/personal-brand content, memes, UGC-style content, AI avatar videos, product/service demos, podcast and interview clips, trending content, and direct-response ad creatives.



You should know how to adapt one idea for each platform by changing the **hook, format, length, editing, caption, thumbnail, keywords/hashtags and CTA**, rather than posting identical content everywhere.



**You should understand:** content calendars, trend and competitor research, social SEO, keyword and hashtag research, audience growth, cross-promotion, collaborations, community engagement, posting frequency, and testing formats, hooks and CTAs.



## Video Production, Editing & Clipping



You'll turn phone footage, raw video, Zoom/Loom recordings, podcasts, interviews, webinars, testimonials, long-form video and AI-generated footage into polished, high-retention social content and ads.



**You should understand:** strong 1–3 second hooks, pattern interrupts, captions/subtitles, B-roll, cuts and zooms, music and sound effects, visual storytelling, retention editing, direct-response CTAs, 9:16 vertical plus 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9 versions, and platform-specific lengths and formats.



**Intelligent repurposing, not random clipping:** a single 30–60 minute recording should become 10–30+ pieces, such as short clips, multiple hooks and CTAs, ad variations, quote graphics, carousels, LinkedIn posts, tweets/Threads and
 content. LIVE sessions should also be repurposed into Reels, TikToks, Shorts and ads.



Professional camera skills are a plus, but making effective modern social video matters more than traditional cinematography.



## AI Content & Creative Production



AI should be part of your everyday workflow. You should be able to take an idea through:

**Script → Voice → Avatar/Actor → Video → B-roll → Captions → CTA → Multiple Creative Variations**



You should also keep researching and testing new AI platforms instead of depending on just one tool.



## Tools We Use or Are Exploring



- **AI creative:** Higgsfield, HeyGen, TryHolo.ai, Blaze.ai, Zeely.ai, MuAPI.ai, Arcads, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, ElevenLabs, plus AI image, video, avatar and voice generators

- **Editing/clipping:** OpusClip, CapCut, Canva, Descript, Riverside, Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and other emerging tools

- **Scheduling/automation:** native schedulers, Meta Business Suite, GoHighLevel, Blaze, Holo, Zeely, MuAPI, other scheduling tools, Make, n8n, Zapier, APIs/webhooks

- *
/outreach:** Instantly.ai, GoHighLevel, Smartlead, Apollo, Mailchimp, Klaviyo or similar



## TikTok LIVE & Live Content



Being comfortable and natural on camera and LIVE is important for this role. You may:

- Host or co-host TikTok LIVE, and take part in Instagram,
 and YouTube LIVE

- Speak confidently and naturally in English

- Present products or services, interview guests, and bring influencers and creators on

- Answer viewer questions, moderate chat and keep viewers engaged

- Drive viewers to CTAs to generate followers, leads, appointments or sales

- Test LIVE concepts and review LIVE analytics



## Influencers, Creators, UGC & Affiliates



You should understand the difference between **paying an influencer for access to their audience** and **paying a UGC creator to make content we can use ourselves**.



**Responsibilities:**

- Research and find nano-, micro- and larger influencers, UGC creators and affiliates

- Evaluate audience quality and engagement, and spot fake or low-quality audiences

- Handle outreach and follow-up, and negotiate pricing and deliverables

- Write creative briefs, coordinate production, review and approve content, and track deliverables

- Manage affiliate links and promo codes

- Build long-term creator and ambassador relationships

- Coordinate collaborations and LIVE appearances



Strong creator content may be reused for organic social, Meta/TikTok/YouTube ads, Spark Ads, Partnership Ads, retargeting and landing pages.



## Paid Media / Performance Marketing



Hands-on advertising experience is essential.



- **Meta:**
 & Instagram Ads, Meta Ads Manager

- **Google/YouTube:** Search, Display, Performance Max, YouTube Ads, retargeting

- **TikTok:** TikTok Ads Manager, Spark Ads, creator-based ads

- **LinkedIn:** Campaign Manager, B2B lead generation

- **Snapchat:** Snapchat Ads

- **A plus:** Pinterest Ads, Reddit Ads, X Ads and emerging platforms



**You should understand:** campaign structure and objectives, audiences and segmentation, retargeting, lookalike audiences, creative and A/B testing, offers and hooks, landing pages, Meta Pixel/CAPI, Google conversion tracking, UTMs, GA4, Google Tag Manager and attribution.



Creative and media buying have to work together. When a creative performs, we want to understand why it worked and quickly produce more variations.



## Automated Content & Distribution



You should be comfortable with both careful manual publishing and AI-assisted, high-volume automated publishing. You don't need to be an automation engineer, but you should understand how automation increases output and when human review, creative judgment and manual intervention are needed.



##
, Outbound & Lead Nurture



Social content and campaigns connect to the broader lead-generation engine. You may help with influencer and prospect outreach,
 campaign copy, AI-personalized outbound, segmentation, follow-up sequences, newsletters, promotional campaigns, lead nurture, and turning strong social content into
.



## Copywriting & Creative Strategy



You must write strong marketing messaging with or without AI: hooks, headlines, storytelling, direct-response copy, CTAs, offers, pain points, objections, benefits vs. features, curiosity, social proof, authority, urgency, educational marketing and founder/personal-brand voice. AI can help you work faster, but the result should never read as generic or obviously AI-written.



## Community & Reputation



Social media is a conversation. You may monitor and respond to comments, handle appropriate DMs, spot sales opportunities, escalate customer-service issues, engage relevant accounts, find creators through community interaction, build relationships with frequent supporters and protect brand reputation.



## Analytics & Optimization



- **Organic:** followers, reach, impressions, views, engagement, comments, shares, saves, watch time, retention, completion rate, profile visits, link clicks

- **Paid:** spend, CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, CPA, CAC, ROAS, leads, appointments, sales, revenue

- **Influencers/creators:** cost per creator, reach, views, engagement, clicks, leads, sales, CPA, creator ROI



We don't want reports that just say "followers increased." We want: **what happened → why it happened → what to test or change next.**



## Ideal Background



Someone who combines social media, content creation, video editing, creative strategy, influencer/UGC, paid media, AI content and growth marketing. Strong candidates may have:

- 4+ years in social, digital or growth marketing

- Hands-on Meta Ads and Google Ads experience

- TikTok and YouTube/Shorts marketing experience

- Influencer, UGC or affiliate campaign experience

- Short-form video editing and AI image/video/content experience

- Organic audience growth experience

- Strong English communication, plus on-camera and LIVE experience

- Experience with US businesses and with lead-generation, conversion-focused marketing



We care more about demonstrated ability, marketing instincts, creativity, technical comfort and fast learning than mastery of every platform.



## This Role Is Not a Fit If You Mainly:

- Schedule content made by someone else

- Only create Canva templates

- Have never personally run ad campaigns

- Are uncomfortable with video or unwilling to appear LIVE

- Don't understand analytics

- Have never worked with creators or influencers

- Avoid learning new tools

- Need detailed instructions for every task

- Believe social media marketing means "posting every day"



## How to Apply: Proof Required



Please don't just send a résumé listing tools. Show us what you've actually done.



1. **Organic social:** One account you personally helped grow. Include starting and ending followers, time period, reach/views where available, and exactly what you did.

2. **Paid advertising:** One campaign you personally managed. Include platform, objective, ad spend, CPL/CPA/CAC/ROAS where applicable, exactly what you managed, and a screenshot or screen recording where permitted.

3. **Video:** Three videos you personally created or edited, ideally one organic social video, one paid ad/UGC creative and one AI-assisted video. Explain which parts you made.

4. **Influencers/UGC/affiliates:** Your strongest campaign. Include the number and type of creators, outreach process, compensation model, views/reach, leads/sales where available, and your responsibilities.

5. **AI & creative tools:** Which of the tools listed above you've actually used, plus any others you use regularly.

6. **Paid media self-rating (1–10):** Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Snapchat Ads. For any score of 8+, be ready to screen-share a real campaign you worked on.

7. **TikTok LIVE test:** A 2–3 minute mock TikTok LIVE promoting any product or service. It should have a strong opening hook, a natural presentation, an answer to an imaginary viewer question, a clear CTA and engaging delivery.

8. **Loom (required):** A short Loom introducing yourself and screen-sharing the accounts you've worked on, content you made, one ad campaign, one influencer/UGC campaign, your favorite AI/content tools, and why you can handle this role.



Applications with real proof of work get priority.



## What Success Looks Like



- You see a 30-minute podcast and think: *"I can turn this into 25 strong pieces of content."*

- You see a high-performing TikTok and think: *"I know why this hook worked, and I can make five variations."*

- You see the right creator and think: *"Their audience matches our customer. Let's build a partnership."*

- You see a winning ad and think: *"Let's make more variations before performance drops."*

- You find a new AI platform and think: *"Can this make our content faster, better or more scalable?"*



Most importantly, you take ownership of audience growth, leads, conversions and measurable results, not just a posting schedule.

title: HIRING NOW: Meta Ads & Marketing Automation Specialist
description:
HIRING: Meta Ads & Marketing Automation Specialist



Position:
/Instagram Ads & GoHighLevel Automation Specialist



Job Type: Remote | Part-Time to Start | Long-Term Opportunity



Compensation: Based on experience and proven results



ABOUT THE BUSINESS



We are a growing business education company that teaches entrepreneurs how to generate income through daily salon space rentals.



We currently host free weekly webinars that attract potential customers and convert attendees into buyers of our educational products.



Our webinars are already performing well organically, and we’re ready to scale through strategic paid advertising.



We are looking for an experienced, results-driven Meta Ads Specialist who also understands marketing funnels, tracking systems, retargeting, and GoHighLevel automations.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply knows how to boost posts or generate website traffic. We need someone who knows how to turn advertising dollars into actual registrations and sales.



OUR PRIMARY GOAL



Our goal is to consistently generate:



* 300+ qualified webinar registrations per week.

* 100+ live attendees remaining when our offer is presented.

* A consistent flow of qualified leads through
 and Instagram advertising.

* Lower acquisition costs through effective targeting, testing, and optimization.

* Accurate conversion tracking so we know which advertisements are producing results.



We want to build a reliable, repeatable advertising system that can scale as the business grows.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. META ADS MANAGEMENT



* Create, launch, manage, and optimize
 and Instagram ad campaigns.

* Develop effective audience targeting strategies for our ideal customers.

* Build campaigns focused on actual webinar registrations, not just clicks or engagement.

* Research and test audiences, ad creatives, messaging, and campaign strategies.

* Manage daily and weekly advertising budgets.

* Monitor campaign performance and adjust spending based on results.

* Scale successful campaigns without unnecessarily increasing acquisition costs.



2. RETARGETING STRATEGY



* Develop strategic retargeting campaigns for people who have engaged with our business but haven’t registered.

* Retarget website visitors and previous ad engagers.

* Create custom audiences and lookalike audiences where appropriate.

* Develop retargeting strategies for webinar registrants, no-shows, and nonbuyers.

* Build a system that continuously brings interested prospects back into our funnel.



3. PIXEL & CONVERSION TRACKING



This is extremely important.



We need someone who understands how to properly install, configure, test, and troubleshoot:



* Meta Pixel

* Meta Conversions API (CAPI)

* Custom conversion events

* Website and funnel tracking

* UTM tracking

* GoHighLevel conversion attribution

* Retargeting audiences



We must be able to identify how many people actually registered for our webinar as a result of our advertisements.



We do not want to spend money on campaigns without knowing what they are producing.



4. GOHIGHLEVEL & MARKETING AUTOMATIONS



Experience with GoHighLevel is strongly preferred.



Responsibilities include:



* Connecting advertising campaigns to our existing GoHighLevel funnels.

* Setting up and improving webinar registration workflows.

* Creating automated
 and SMS confirmation and reminder sequences.

* Improving systems designed to increase webinar attendance.

* Organizing contacts and leads using tags, workflows, and segmentation.

* Building follow-up automations for people who register but don’t attend.

* Creating post-webinar follow-up and retargeting systems.

* Troubleshooting automations and ensuring everything works correctly.



5. PERFORMANCE TRACKING & REPORTING



We want someone who is analytical and understands how to make decisions based on data.



You must be able to monitor and report:



* Total advertising spend

* Cost per webinar registration

* Number of verified webinar registrations

* Registration conversion rate

* Webinar attendance rate

* Cost per live attendee

* Number of purchases generated

* Cost per customer acquisition

* Return on advertising spend (ROAS)



We expect consistent communication, performance updates, and recommendations backed by actual numbers.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



* Proven experience managing successful Meta advertising campaigns.

* Experience generating leads or registrations for webinars, courses, coaching programs, or digital products.

* Strong knowledge of audience targeting and retargeting.

* Experience with Meta Pixel and Conversions API.

* Understanding of conversion-focused campaigns.

* Experience working with GoHighLevel.

* Ability to build and troubleshoot marketing automations.

* Strong analytical and reporting skills.

* Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is proactive, strategic, and results-oriented.



You should be able to look at a campaign, identify why it isn’t converting, and know what needs to be tested or improved.



We value someone who can independently manage our advertising systems, provide strategic recommendations, and help us scale.



This is an opportunity to grow with a business that already has a proven offer, established audience, existing sales, and a functioning webinar funnel.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer the following questions in your application:



1. How many years of experience do you have managing Meta ads?

2. Have you previously managed advertising campaigns specifically for webinars, online courses, or digital products?

title: Inbound Sales & Booking Coordinator (U.S. Moving Company) – Part-Time, Remote
description:
## About Us



Strong Household Movers is a growing professional moving company based in Tennessee, USA. We provide residential and commercial moving services, including local moves, long-distance moves, loading, and unloading.



We are seeking a reliable, confident, and sales-driven **Inbound Sales & Booking Coordinator** to answer customer calls, provide moving quotes, schedule estimates, and convert incoming leads into confirmed bookings.



**This is a sales-focused position, not simply a call-answering role.** Many of our customers are ready to book when they call, so we need someone who can communicate confidently, build trust, and close sales professionally.



## Job Responsibilities



- Answer incoming calls from U.S. customers promptly and professionally.

- Explain our moving services, pricing, hourly rates, and policies.

- Convert incoming inquiries into confirmed moving bookings.

- Collect customer information, moving dates, addresses, inventory details, and special requirements.

- Schedule free in-home estimates for larger moving jobs.

- Check crew availability and coordinate scheduling.

- Follow up with customers who received estimates but haven't booked.

- Handle customer questions and price objections professionally.

- Enter and maintain accurate information in our booking system.

- Send booking confirmations and payment instructions through approved company systems.

- Provide daily reports on calls, leads, estimates, and confirmed bookings.



## Requirements



- Excellent spoken and written English with clear pronunciation.

- At least 1 year of experience in inbound sales, appointment setting, or U.S. customer service preferred.

- Strong communication, persuasion, and closing skills.

- Experience handling U.S. customers by phone.

- Ability to work independently and handle multiple customer inquiries.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection, computer, headset, and quiet workspace.

- Comfortable using CRM systems, scheduling software, and web applications.

- Willingness to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



**Experience in moving companies, home services, logistics, or transportation is a major advantage.**



## Work Schedule



- Monday–Friday

- 8:30 AM–1:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time

- 25 hours per week

- Fully remote, Philippines-based position



## Compensation



- Starting pay: **$6 USD per hour**

- Approximately $650 USD per month

- Opportunity for performance-based bonuses tied to successful bookings.

- Potential for increased hours and compensation based on performance.



## How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your résumé highlighting relevant customer service and sales experience.

2. A 60–90-second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your experience handling U.S. customers.

3. A brief explanation of how you would convince a customer to book our moving service when they say our price is higher than a competitor's.

4. Your internet speed and confirmation that you can work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule.



**Important:** We are looking for someone who can turn incoming calls into paying customers. Applicants with demonstrated inbound sales and closing experience will receive priority consideration.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid mock customer-call assessment.

title: Project Manager - Product Launches (Executive Partner)
description:
Project Manager - Product Launches (Executive Partner)



💼 Full Time | Remote | USD $1,100 to $1,600 per month

📍 Philippines-based | 9:00am to 6:00pm PHT, weekdays



Hello Nancy went from 9 products in the pipeline to 38 in two weeks. The launch schedule for all of them lives in about 55 group chats and in two people's heads. There is no system of record.



Your job is to build one, then run it. If you work best inside a scope someone else has already drawn, this is not the right role.



---



✨ About Ally



Ally helps founders and leaders scale themselves before they scale their companies.



We match Executive Partners with fast-growing e-commerce and creative businesses, bringing structure, clarity and execution leverage. We combine human judgment with modern AI tools.



We are not a VA agency. Our partners run real parts of the business, with direct access to the founder and real decisions to make.



---



 🧭 The role



You own product launches for Hello Nancy, working directly with the co-founder.  The brand is in sexual wellness, so you should be comfortable working on intimate products every day. Two people currently hold the whole launch pipeline in their heads, and one of them is at capacity. You take it off them.



The founder's own description of the job: bring order to the chaos, get everyone aligned, and make sure we know early if we are going to miss a timeline and what that costs.



You will recommend the tracking tool, build it, and keep it true. Nobody will hand you a process. The product judgment stays with the team. The coordination, the dates and the follow-through are yours.



---



📋 What you'll do



1. The launch tracker, about 40%



- Keep roughly twenty gated steps true for every product, so the launch date and the on-track flag actually mean something

- Read the factory, designer and 3PL threads daily across WhatsApp and WeChat, and move what matters into the tracker the same day

- Run the artwork rounds, keep version control, and route the founder's sign-off

- Know which artwork and print file is current for any live product, and who confirmed it

- Separate what is on track, what is at risk and what needs the founder. Never one flat list

- Flag date conflicts before they hit a deadline



2. The chase, about 25%



- Run a weekly supplier chase. Every open commitment asked, every answer logged yes or no

- Chase samples, tooling, packaging development and factory dates

- Chase designers for review rounds and the founders for the decisions that are only theirs



3. The handoffs, about 20%



- Give the fulfilment lead launch dates and volumes far enough ahead to place an order on a 30-day production lead, so nothing lands as a surprise

- Tell whoever placed a purchase order about any design change before it is made, the same day. It may move the price

- Send the marketing lead the current spec every time it changes, and a clean product sample three weeks before launch. Packaging follows separately and later

- Send tester and influencer samples against the list once a product is approved to proceed

- Keep the current 3D render in the file library beside the diecuts and print files

- Say when a new version exists, so it gets its own code. Every version gets a new one, always

- Send one weekly round-up to everyone who needs it, unprompted



4. The product brief, and systems, about 15%



- The brief belongs to someone else today. You draft it from day 30 and own it from day 60, with the founder seeing it before it reaches the designer

- One page: spec, barcode, code and one line of art direction. Art direction is a feeling in the world of the product, not a materials spec

- Remove any claim with no source behind it, and keep a record of the evidence per claim

- Recommend one tracking tool with your reasons, build it, and get the team working in it rather than around it

- Build the automations that remove repeat compiling, check the output by hand, and know what happens when they fail



---



🚦 What is not yours



Stated up front so the line is clear from day one:



- Approvals, and the final call on whether something is good enough to print

- The factory relationships

- Building the internal system. You run it, someone else builds and fixes it

- Quotes, purchase orders, payment terms, warehousing and forecasting. Those sit with the fulfilment side

- Anything after mass production. Campaigns and post-launch performance are someone else's



---



📈 What success looks like



These are the real dated bars for the role, not aspirations.



- Week 1 hands-on. Week 2 output every two days. Weeks 3 to 4 self-sufficient, with no call-outs. That is the ramp, and it is short on purpose. Nobody here has time to train

- Day 7: every active product in the tracker shows its step, a ready-on date, and which file is current. Nobody has had to ask you where anything is

- Day 14: the weekly chase is running and logged. One product has moved end to end. You flagged a date conflict before anyone else saw it

- Day 30: the person who was doing launch coordination before you spends a full week not doing it. The weekly round-up has gone out four weeks running. You have drafted a product brief the founder saw before the designer did

- Day 60: the brief is yours and gets reviewed, not rewritten. Any claim on any pack has a source someone can pull up in a minute. You have caught a production spec that differed from the prototype, before artwork

- Day 90: someone outside the team can be handed a date and update the system correctly, without you



---



📐 How the work is judged



Read these before you apply. They are the standard from day one, not after onboarding.



- You bring a recommendation, not a blank question. A screenshot with no view attached is not the job. You will approve nothing in month one, and that is reviewed at day 30, so your judgment shows up in what you recommend

- When you need a decision, it takes three lines: what needs d
, what you recommend, and what happens if nobody answers by a date you name. The third line is the one that matters

- You ask the person directly. The founder hears about it when he is the only one who can d
, or when you have asked twice and got nothing. Changing something and telling the founder is not telling the person it affects

- You do not report what has not changed. No status re-sent, nothing already in the tracker, nothing that belongs to someone else

- Something corrected once does not get corrected twice. This is the founder's stated hiring bar

- You reply inside an hour on WhatsApp and WeChat during work hours

- You get stuck out loud, early. Say what you do not understand and what you need. Silence is the failure, not the question

- You stop a payment, a claim or a commitment until it is checked, including when the founder is the one asking for speed



---



🎯 What we're looking for



Must-haves



- Project management: 3+ years running projects end to end with multiple outside parties and dates that genuinely move

- A system that outlived you: you built a tracker or process that other people used after you built it, not one you kept for yourself. Be ready to show it

- The quality of what you ask: your questions close a real gap. You check what you already have before asking, and you do not ask for confirmation of something you already know. This is the single most common reason this kind of role fails here

- Pace: productive in week one and independent by week four, from a short walkthrough and a weekly 30 minutes. No training program exists

- Volume with judgment: you can reconcile a day of supplier messages against a tracker with no wrong date or quantity, and say what is missing rather than logging everything flat

- Brief writing: clear written English, short and status first. Direct feedback daily, and it is expected back

- Channels: comfortable with WhatsApp and WeChat as primary work channels

- AI fluency: a concrete example of a recurring task you removed using AI



Strongly preferred



- Physical goods: supply chain, manufacturing, packaging or 3PL exposure

- Discretion: you have handled suppliers who must not learn about each other

- Tools: Notion, ClickUp or similar, and you have an opinion on which and why



---



💡 What you'll get



- USD $1,100 to $1,600 per month, depending on experience

- Fully remote, long-term, from anywhere in the Philippines

- 9:00am to 6:00pm PHT. Occasional after hours by agreement, not nightly

- Client-paid AI subscription, and you name the tools that make the work faster

- A direct line to the founder. Feedback is daily, one line, sometimes blunt

- You build the system rather than inherit one



---



Apply here: 





Bring your CV and a portfolio link, plus one 2–3 minute Loom:

1. Introduce yourself and the parts of your background most relevant to this role.

2. Tell us about a project where nobody had defined the scope. What did you do in week one, and what did you set up that others ended up using?



If you build the system instead of asking for one, this is your next role. Apply today and own the launch pipeline of a consumer brand scaling fast.

title: B2B & Ecommerce Order Fulfillment Specialist
description:
OPERATIONS COORDINATOR

B2B Sales & Fulfillment, Customer Experience, Listings & Systems

Full-time | Remote (overlaps US business hours) | Reports to Lisa Hu, Founder & CEO





ABOUT LUX & NYX



Lux & Nyx designs architectural handbags for professional women who refuse to choose between style and function. Featured in Forbes, Refinery29, NPR, and Marie Claire. We sell across Shopify DTC, Amazon, Nordstrom, and Macy's, and through a corporate gifting channel served by promotional-products distributors. Remote-first team led by founder Lisa Hu. We move fast. We build systems that compound. We hire people who can think and ship.





THE ROLE



You'll own our corporate gifting business from the first
 to the day the order lands. Nearly every inquiry comes from a promotional-products distributor who is pitching Lux & Nyx to their client. You answer them the same day, send quotes they can trust, and follow every open quote until it becomes a yes or a no. When it becomes a yes, you plan the order backward from the date it has to arrive: artwork, decoration, kitting, cartons, labels, and shipping, with every party lined up in time. You'll also look after our direct-to-consumer customers, keep our marketplace listings and systems current, and take on new system updates as the business grows.



This role is half conversation and half precision. You need to be warm and confident with a buyer, and you need to refuse to send anything when a number doesn't add up. The most valuable thing you do is tell a distributor exactly what it takes to hit their date, before anyone promises it.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



1. Inquiries & quotes: answer distributor and corporate inquiries the same business day. Quote price, minimums, colorways, decoration options, and lead times accurately, and check stock and the timeline before you commit to any date.



2. Quote follow-up: keep every open quote in our pipeline tracker with a next step and the client's event date. Quotes often stay open for months, so you check in with each distributor on a steady cadence and time your follow-ups to their client's deadline, so nothing goes quiet without a decision.



3. Order entry & confirmation: when a quote becomes an order, re-check stock, pricing, and timing before you confirm. Log every PO clean, and make sure the PO, the quote, and the confirmation all match before anything goes out.



4. Backward planning: for every dated order, build the timeline back from the in-hand date: when art must be approved, when the designer and decorator must start, when the warehouse kits and ships. Then make sure each person gets what they need on time.



5. Pack-out & shipping: work out cartons and shipping labels from our pack-out spec (a partial carton is still a carton), confirm counts with the warehouse before labels are made, and run a final check before anything ships. If a number isn't on file, you go get it. You never estimate it.



6. DTC customer experience: answer customer
s and messages from our own site and social within 24 hours, warmly and in our brand voice: order questions, product questions, and warranty and return requests, handled by our policies and followed through to resolution.



7. Marketplace & catalog listings: manage our product listings on Amazon, Nordstrom, and our Mirakl-based retailer marketplaces, plus B2B supplier catalogs (such as ESP, SAGE, and distributor and rewards platforms). That means day-to-day product data entry and updates (images, pricing, specs) whenever a product, price, or color changes, checked against our master sheet and followed through until each listing is live and correct. Larger batch uploads are handled with a marketplace specialist.



8. Systems, updates & SOPs: keep one source of truth for quotes, orders, and product data, take on other system and data updates across our platforms as they come up, and write down every step so the process never lives in one person's head.



9. AI & tooling (evolving): use AI to speed up drafting and repetitive steps where it helps, and help shape what's worth automating.



Not part of this role: Amazon and retail-marketplace customer service (another teammate owns that), and cold outbound prospecting (our founder and sales consultant own that).





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



1. You stop rather than send. If a price, date, or count doesn't reconcile, nothing goes out until it does. That's the #1 thing.

2. You plan backward from the deadline. Give you an in-hand date and you can tell us the date every step has to start, and who needs to hear about it first.

3. 3+ years in B2B order management: promotional products, corporate gifting, wholesale, or similar, with orders that run for weeks across several outside parties (vendors, decorators, warehouses, carriers).

4. Clear, polished English, written and spoken. You can hold a buyer conversation on your own, quote with confidence, and say "here's what it takes" instead of an easy yes. With our direct customers, you're warm, quick, and on-brand.

5. Organized follow-through on a pipeline: dozens of open quotes at once, each with a next step, none forgotten.

6. A builder. When something was never written down, you write it down, get it checked, and make it the standard.

7. Comfortable with product data entry and uploads from spreadsheet templates, with zero tolerance for a wrong price or spec going live. We'll train you on our marketplace SOPs. Amazon Seller Central, retailer-portal (Nordstrom, Mirakl), or supplier-catalog (ESP, SAGE) experience is a plus.

8. Comfortable with the tools: Shopify, spreadsheets with formulas, a CRM or pipeline tracker, and AI for drafting.

9. Calm and steady in async, remote, founder-led work, with meaningful overlap with US business hours.

10. Here for the long haul: someone who wants to own this work and get great at it, not use it as a stepping stone.





WHAT SEPARATES GREAT FROM GOOD



1. Tells a distributor "here's what it takes to hit your date" instead of just yes or no.

2. Notices the number that's missing, and goes and gets it instead of guessing.

3. Briefs the designer at the start of the order, not the end.

4. Follows up because a deadline is coming, not just because time has passed.

5. Documents as they go, so nothing lives in one person's head.

6. Steady when gifting season hits.





HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



Targets calibrate quarterly. These are the outcomes you'll actually be measured on:



- Inquiry response: same business day

- DTC customer response: every inquiry answered in under 24h; nothing dropped

- Quote accuracy: zero quotes sent with a wrong price, minimum, or lead time

- Quote follow-through: every open quote tracked with a next step; none goes quiet without a decision

- On-time delivery: every B2B order arrives by its in-hand date

- Order & shipment accuracy: zero incomplete shipments; cartons = labels = packing list

- Listing accuracy: zero live errors (price / spec / image) on Amazon, retailer portals, and B2B catalogs

- Pre-send checks: zero documents released with a number that doesn't reconcile

- SOP coverage: every recurring step documented





HOW WE WORK TOGETHER



1. Weekly 1:1 with Lisa (founder & CEO): priorities, open quotes, what's shipping, and what's at risk.

2. Day-to-day coordination with Michelle (operations) and our warehouse team on fulfillment.

3. Quarterly planning: themes, major moments (holiday, gifting season), and KPI targets.

4. Async-first via Slack: decisions documented, same-day response on blockers.





COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



Competitive compensation tied to experience and location. Paid PTO. Health stipend. Remote-first culture with intentional async work.





HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word CLEAN, and in three sentences tell us about an order with a hard deadline that you planned backward from: what had to happen when, and who you had to line up. Then attach your resume. Applications that skip either step won't be read.



That one line is deliberate: it's how we see, before we ever meet, whether you read carefully and whether you own the details instead of waiting for someone to catch them for you.





OUR HIRING PROCESS



We keep it simple and respect your time:

1. Apply: the word CLEAN, three sentences, and your resume.

2. If shortlisted: a short recorded answer (3–5 minutes) to a few questions we send you.

3. If invited: a paid skills test based on real work ($30, about 4 hours, paid regardless of outcome).

4. Final steps: an interview with our founder and reference check.



We reply to every shortlisted applicant and aim to make a decision within 3 weeks.





ABOUT THE TEAM



We're a remote-first team. We run on weekly syncs, regular 1:1s, and quarterly goal-setting. We lead before we're asked. We think from the customer's perspective. We grow with intention. We think deeply before we act. If that's how you work too, we'd love to meet you.

* Assist with appointment scheduling and client onboarding coordination.

* Learn our services, pricing, and booking procedures quickly.



REQUIRED Qualifications



GOHIGHLEVEL EXPERIENCE IS MANDATORY!



Applicants MUST have hands-on experience using GoHighLevel, including:



* Managing contacts, opportunities, and sales pipelines.

* Communicating with leads through GHL.

* Managing tasks, appointments, and follow-up workflows.

* Updating lead statuses and maintaining accurate CRM records.

* Navigating the platform independently with minimal supervision.



Additional Requirements:



* Proven experience in sales, lead conversion, or appointment closing.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* A warm, friendly, outgoing, and personable personality.

* Strong communication skills and the ability to make clients feel comfortable and valued.

* Confidence discussing pricing, overcoming objections, and closing sales.

* Fast learner who can quickly understand and explain our nursing care packages.

* Highly organized, dependable, proactive, and detail-oriented.

* Comfortable making outbound calls and following up with potential clients.

* Reliable internet connection and a professional, quiet workspace.



What Makes You a Great Fit?



You have a naturally beautiful personality that shines through the phone!



You are enthusiastic, approachable, and genuinely enjoy speaking with people. You understand that great sales are about building trust, not just pushing a service.



You are confident without being aggressive, persuasive without being pushy, and know how to make every potential client feel heard and cared for.



Experience in healthcare, cosmetic surgery, medical tourism, or service-based sales is a PLUS!



Compensation



We offer competitive compensation based on experience, with opportunities for performance-based bonuses and long-term growth.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, please submit:



1. Your resume and a brief introduction about yourself.

2. A summary of your previous sales experience, including the services or products you’ve sold.

3. Details of your hands-on experience with GoHighLevel.

4. A short voice recording (60–90 seconds) introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a great fit for our sales team.

5. Your expected hourly rate in USD.



IMPORTANT: Applications without demonstrated GoHighLevel experience will not be considered.



We look forward to finding a confident, energetic, and personable sales professional to grow with the Drip N Bodied team!

title: Job Title: Fleet Acquisition & Lead Generation Specialist — Part-Time
description:
**Job Title: Fleet Acquisition & Lead Generation Specialist — Part-Time**



FLEXX Prestige Rentals is a Las Vegas rental car company looking for someone who can help us connect with vehicle owners interested in adding their cars to our fleet.



**Our goal: add 5 qualified vehicles before the end of the year.**



We need someone who can start conversations, build relationships, follow up, and book qualified calls with our owner.



**Your responsibilities:**

• Find potential vehicle partners through referrals, local businesses, social media, and automotive communities.

• Reach out with personalized messages using approved company accounts.

• Build connections with body shops, dealerships, and other potential referral partners.

• Collect vehicle details: year, make, model, mileage, condition, location, and availability.

• Follow up with interested owners and schedule calls.

• Keep an organized lead tracker and submit a short daily progress report.



**What we’re looking for:**

• Experience in lead generation, appointment setting, or sales outreach.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Confidence handling questions and starting conversations.

• Consistent follow-up and good organization.

• Automotive or rental industry experience is a plus.



**Schedule and compensation:**

• Start at 10 hours per week, with some availability during Las Vegas business hours.

• Hourly pay based on experience, plus a performance bonus for each qualified vehicle successfully onboard.

• Opportunity for more hours based on results.



We provide company information, outreach guidance, vehicle requirements, and training. Our owner handles final negotiations and agreements. You will not be expected to guarantee earnings or collect money.



**How to apply:**

Use “FLEXX Fleet Growth” as your application subject and include:

1. Your relevant experience and results.

2. A short sample message to a vehicle owner about our rental management service.

3. Two ways you would find interested vehicle owners beyond
 Marketplace.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid trial.

title: NOW HIRING: Remote Sales Representative / Lead Conversion Specialist
description:
NOW HIRING: Remote Sales Representative / Lead Conversion Specialist



Company: Drip N Bodied

Industry: Healthcare | Cosmetic Surgery | Post-Operative Nursing Care

Location: Remote (International Applicants Welcome)

Schedule: Must be available during U.S. Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours

Compensation: Competitive Pay 



About Us



Drip N Bodied is a nurse-owned, Miami-based concierge nursing company specializing in professional post-operative care for patients undergoing cosmetic surgery.



We are looking for a highly motivated, personable, and experienced Sales Representative to join our growing team!



Our ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys connecting with people, has an outgoing and welcoming personality, and knows how to confidently turn inquiries into booked clients.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply answers phones. We need a confident salesperson who knows how to build relationships, communicate value, follow up consistently, and CLOSE SALES!



Key Responsibilities



* Respond promptly to incoming leads via phone, SMS,
, and other communication channels.

* Conduct friendly, engaging sales consultations with prospective clients.

* Educate potential clients on our post-operative nursing care services and packages.

* Build genuine rapport, establish trust, and confidently guide clients through the booking process.

* Convert qualified leads into paying clients.

* Consistently follow up with interested prospects to maximize conversions.

* Manage and update leads, opportunities, and sales pipelines in GoHighLevel (GHL).

* Track sales activity, follow-ups, and conversion performance.

* Assist with appointment scheduling and client onboarding coordination.

* Learn our services, pricing, and booking procedures quickly.



REQUIRED Qualifications



GOHIGHLEVEL EXPERIENCE IS MANDATORY!



Applicants MUST have hands-on experience using GoHighLevel, including:



* Managing contacts, opportunities, and sales pipelines.

* Communicating with leads through GHL.

* Managing tasks, appointments, and follow-up workflows.

* Updating lead statuses and maintaining accurate CRM records.

* Navigating the platform independently with minimal supervision.



Additional Requirements:



* Proven experience in sales, lead conversion, or appointment closing.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* A warm, friendly, outgoing, and personable personality.

* Strong communication skills and the ability to make clients feel comfortable and valued.

* Confidence discussing pricing, overcoming objections, and closing sales.

* Fast learner who can quickly understand and explain our nursing care packages.

* Highly organized, dependable, proactive, and detail-oriented.

* Comfortable making outbound calls and following up with potential clients.

* Reliable internet connection and a professional, quiet workspace.



What Makes You a Great Fit?



You have a naturally beautiful personality that shines through the phone!



You are enthusiastic, approachable, and genuinely enjoy speaking with people. You understand that great sales are about building trust, not just pushing a service.



You are confident without being aggressive, persuasive without being pushy, and know how to make every potential client feel heard and cared for.



Experience in healthcare, cosmetic surgery, medical tourism, or service-based sales is a PLUS!



Compensation



We offer competitive compensation based on experience, with opportunities for performance-based bonuses and long-term growth.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, please submit:



1. Your resume and a brief introduction about yourself.

2. A summary of your previous sales experience, including the services or products you’ve sold.

3. Details of your hands-on experience with GoHighLevel.

4. A short voice recording (60–90 seconds) introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a great fit for our sales team.

5. Your expected hourly rate in USD.



IMPORTANT: Applications without demonstrated GoHighLevel experience will not be considered.



We look forward to finding a confident, energetic, and personable sales professional to grow with the Drip N Bodied team!

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. title: Real Estate Lead Follow-Up & CRM Specialist
description:
About the Role

Our client, a real estate professional based in Hawaii, is looking for a reliable, proactive, and detail-oriented Real Estate Lead Follow-Up & CRM Specialist to support lead generation and client outreach.



The primary responsibility of this role is to make outbound calls to internet leads generated through Google Pay-Per-Click (PPC) advertising, follow up with potential buyers and sellers, and accurately document conversations in Real Geeks CRM.



This is a phone-focused role for someone who is confident communicating with prospects, has strong English communication skills, and can consistently follow up with leads without letting opportunities fall through the cracks.



Over time, the role may expand to include additional administrative tasks and the implementation of AI-powered lead follow-up systems through automated calls, text messages, and other communication channels.



Responsibilities

• Making outbound calls to internet leads generated through Google PPC advertising

• Following up with potential buyers and sellers to understand their needs, interests, and timelines

• Using established buyer and seller phone scripts to engage and qualify leads

• Recording call outcomes, conversations, and detailed notes in Real Geeks CRM

• Updating lead information, statuses, and follow-up activities in the CRM

• Scheduling follow-up calls and ensuring leads receive consistent communication

• Identifying qualified prospects and potential opportunities for the realtor

• Assisting with follow-up through phone calls, text messages, and other communication channels

• Helping implement and manage AI-powered lead follow-up tools, including automated texting and calling

• Learning and adapting to the client's existing processes, software, and lead management systems

• Taking on additional administrative tasks as the business grows

• Assisting with marketing or social media tasks when needed, although this is not a primary responsibility



What We're Looking For

• Previous experience in cold calling, outbound sales, telemarketing, appointment setting, or lead follow-up

• Clear, professional spoken English with an easy-to-understand accent

• Strong English writing skills, especially for CRM notes, follow-up messages, and client communication

• Confidence speaking with potential buyers and sellers over the phone

• Ability to follow scripts while keeping conversations natural and engaging

• Strong attention to detail when entering information and updating CRM records

• Organized, consistent, and reliable with lead follow-up

• Comfortable working with CRM software and learning new technology

• Proactive and able to work independently with minimal supervision

• Willingness to learn AI-powered tools and new lead management processes as they are introduced



The Ideal Candidate

• Has previously worked for a realtor, real estate agent, or real estate team

• Is familiar with common real estate buyer and seller phone scripts

• Has experience qualifying real estate leads and setting appointments

• Has hands-on experience using Real Geeks CRM

• Has worked with internet leads, Google PPC leads, or other paid lead generation sources

• Has experience with automated texting, AI calling, or CRM automation

• Has marketing or social media experience as an added bonus



The Ideal Candidate

You are someone who is comfortable picking up the phone, starting conversations with new prospects, and consistently following up until the next step is clear.



You understand that speed, persistence, and accurate recordkeeping are essential when working with real estate leads. You can communicate professionally, keep the CRM organized, and help the realtor focus on the most promising opportunities.



Experience with real estate and Real Geeks CRM is a major advantage, but the client is also open to someone with strong cold-calling skills who can learn the systems and processes quickly.



If you're looking for a long-term opportunity where you can build your real estate experience, improve lead management processes, and potentially grow into additional responsibilities, we'd love to hear from you.

We do not want generic, copy-paste applications. To apply, please complete all three steps below:

Highlight your experience in cold calling, real estate, lead follow-up, and CRM software.

Tell us about your experience with cold calling or outbound sales. What types of leads have you worked with, and how did you approach them? and Why do you believe you would be a good fit for this role?



3. Complete the Application Form
