Maintain the highest level of professionalism, confidentiality, and attention to detail.



Support additional financial planning and administrative projects as assigned.



Required Qualifications:



Five or more years of professional financial planning experience, including experience with complex client financial situations.



Strong proficiency in eMoney, with the ability to independently build, analyze, and maintain detailed financial plans.



Comprehensive understanding of financial planning principles, including retirement, investments, insurance, taxes, estate planning, and cash flow management.



Experience developing and comparing financial planning scenarios and evaluating alternative strategies.



Ability to identify potential planning issues, question assumptions, and recognize matters requiring advisor or specialist review.



Exceptional attention to detail, analytical skills, and organization.



Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Ability to interpret complex financial information and clearly communicate findings to financial advisors.



Ability to manage multiple planning assignments simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.



Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with a financial planning team.



Professional demeanor with a strong commitment to quality, confidentiality, and client service.



Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.



Preferred Qualifications



CFP® certification or equivalent professional financial planning credentials — a significant advantage.



Advanced experience using eMoney for complex financial planning and scenario modeling.



Prior experience working with U.S.-based financial advisors, financial planning firms, or wealth management organizations.



Experience preparing comprehensive financial plans for high-net-worth individuals, families, and business owners.



Experience with advanced retirement income planning, tax-efficient strategies, and estate planning considerations.



Experience analyzing business ownership interests, succession planning, and business-related financial planning scenarios.



Familiarity with U.S. financial planning concepts, retirement accounts, investment structures, insurance products, and tax considerations.



Experience with financial planning CRM systems and client document management platforms.



Strong ability to identify inconsistencies, missing information, and opportunities for additional planning analysis.



Ability to take initiative, solve problems, and improve financial planning workflows.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means our financial advisors can confidently rely on accurate, current, and comprehensive financial plans that are ready when needed.



You proactively identify missing information, follow up on outstanding items, and ensure financial plans continue progressing without unnecessary delays.



Planning scenarios are thoughtfully developed, assumptions are clearly documented, and findings are organized in a way that allows advisors to easily review, understand, and communicate recommendations to clients.



You take ownership of your work, consistently deliver high-quality financial plans, and become a trusted member of our financial planning team.

Ensign Partners is intentional about building a workplace where people are trusted, supported, and held to high standards. This role is an important part of helping individuals, families, and business owners make confident financial decisions.



Joining Ensign means:



Being part of a mission-driven, people-first firm.

What you will do:

- Paid trial on sample leads only: 50-60 leads in 1 day.

- Dialer access is provided (single-line dialer to start). No full admin access on day one.



Requirements:

- Clear, fluent American English and a confident, professional phone manner.

- Experience cold calling for real estate wholesaling preferred.

- Reliable internet, headset, and a quiet workspace.



How to apply - please include all of the following:

1. A 60-90 second voice recording of you introducing yourself and making a short sample cold call to a motivated seller.

2. A short note about your wholesaling cold-calling experience.

3. The dialers and CRMs you have actually used.

4. Answers to these screening questions:

   a. What are you looking for - a short-term project, a longer project, or a more stable long-term position?

title: eBay Listing Assistant - photo editing, draft listing Jewelry
description:
I have been selling authentic Native American jewelry on eBay for the last 10 years. I have about 1,400 listings and do all the listing work myself. I need a careful, steady helper so I can spend more time finding and photographing new pieces with a goal of growing my number of listings. This is ongoing, part-time work.



HOW IT WORKS

I work in batches of 10 to 20 listings. While you work on one batch, I photograph and prepare the next. You edit the photos and write draft listings. I review every listing and publish it myself.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Edit 8 photos per listing.

- Draft each listing on eBay: title, item specifics, description, condition and price.

- Use the information I give you for stones, materials and who made the piece. You never guess about materials, stones or who made a piece. I give you all of it.

- Work out the price with my formula.

- Check your own work and fix mistakes before you send a batch back.

- After training, write out the steps you follow so we can build step-by-step instructions together.



WHO I AM LOOKING FOR

- Required: 2+ years listing on eBay, including for other sellers. 3+ years preferred. You would be my first VA, so it’s best if you have a listing method you can explain to me.

- Jewelry, antiques or vintage experience is better than general reselling.

- Clear written English.

- Basic photo editing skills, crop, straighten, brighten.

- Careful and steady.



PAY

- $0.75 per listing, including editing 8 photos per listing. Your hourly rate depends on how fast and accurately you work.

- Minimum batch of 10 listings.

- Bonus of $0.25 per listing. You earn it when the listing needs no revisions from me and the whole batch is back within 1 day of when I send it. If you told me ahead that you need more time, the new deadline counts.

- Paid weekly for the first 3 months, then twice a month.



HOURS

About 8 to 12 hours a week to start. I plan to list about 100 items a week once we are up and running. We will start smaller while I learn your method. No fixed schedule, you choose your own hours. I only ask that each batch is back to me within 1 day of when I send it. The 1 day starts when I send you the batch with all photos and information ready. If you need more time, or you will be off or away, you must tell me before the deadline.



PAID TEST

First step is a 5-listing test, done outside my eBay account (titles and descriptions in a Google Doc or sheet, photos in a shared folder). I pay a flat $25 whatever the result. Write down how long each listing took and the steps you followed.



A FINISHED LISTING

A draft with the correct title, all 8 photos edited and in order, item specifics that match my sheet exactly, no typos, the price from my formula, condition set, and my standard footer. If a listing has errors you fix it before it is counted and paid.



HOW TO APPLY

Please reply in your own words with:

1. Your experience listing on eBay for other sellers, and what kinds of items.

2. Any jewelry, antiques or vintage experience.

3. How you prefer to receive photos, for example a Google Drive folder.

4. How many hours a week you can work, and your time zone.

5. Examples of your past listing or photo work, if you can share them.

title: Home Health Therapy - Case Manager

Company: Complete Care Therapy Providers, Inc. (CCTP)

Location: Remote 

Employment Type: Part-Time to Full-Time

Schedule: Aligned with U.S. Pacific Time (California)



About the Role



Complete Care Therapy Providers, Inc. is a growing U.S.-based therapy staffing and administrative support company serving home health agencies throughout Southern California. We connect qualified physical therapists, occupational therapists, speech-language pathologists, and therapy assistants with home health agencies and help coordinate the administrative side of therapy services.



We are looking for a highly organized, reliable, detail-oriented Remote Healthcare Staffing & Administrative Coordinator based in the Philippines to help us manage therapist staffing, documentation follow-up, and daily administrative tasks.



This position is ideal for someone who is comfortable communicating professionally with healthcare professionals, managing multiple tasks simultaneously, following detailed processes, and working independently.



Key Responsibilities



Therapist Staffing & Recruitment



* Maintain an organized database of active, prospective, and inactive therapists.

* Track therapist coverage by city/ZIP code and discipline.

* Identify staffing gaps and help locate therapists for specific geographic areas.

* Coordinate with the owner/management regarding urgent staffing needs.

* Follow up with therapists who have not responded to messages or referrals.



Credentialing & Onboarding



* Assist with collecting and organizing therapist onboarding documents.

* Track licenses, business licenses, CPR certifications, TB/physical requirements, liability insurance, auto insurance, W-9s, resumes, direct deposit information, and other required documents.

* Monitor expiration dates and notify therapists when documents need to be renewed.

* Maintain accurate electronic personnel files.

* Help ensure therapists are fully cleared before receiving patient assignments.



Documentation & Note Verification



* Review therapy documentation for completeness and administrative compliance.

* Verify that required notes have been submitted within the expected timeframe.

* Identify missing, incomplete, or late documentation.

* Follow up with therapists regarding outstanding notes or corrections.

* Track documentation status and communicate issues to management.

* Assist with monitoring documentation through systems such as TherapySync.

* Help ensure therapists are following CCTP documentation procedures.

* Escalate clinical questions or concerns to the appropriate U.S.-based clinical/management staff rather than providing clinical recommendations.



Administrative Support



* Assist with assigning and coordinating patient referrals.

* Maintain therapist and agency spreadsheets/databases.

* Update staffing and referral trackers.

* Assist with
 management and responding to routine administrative inquiries.

* Help organize invoices, visit information, and payroll-related documentation.

* Assist with tracking therapist visits and outstanding administrative items.

* Prepare routine reports for management.

* Perform data entry and other administrative tasks as needed.

* Help improve and maintain internal processes and checklists.



Communication Responsibilities



You will communicate regularly with:



* Physical therapists

* Occupational therapists

* Speech-language pathologists

* PTAs and COTAs

* Home health agencies

* CCTP management



Professional written and verbal English is required. The ability to communicate clearly and professionally through
, phone, text messaging, and video meetings is required 



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is:



* Extremely organized and detail-oriented

* Reliable and responsive

* Comfortable working independently

* Able to manage multiple priorities

* Comfortable communicating with healthcare professionals

* Strong in written and spoken English

* Proficient with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, and

* Comfortable learning new software and healthcare platforms

* Good at following established processes

* Proactive about identifying problems before they become larger issues

* Comfortable with repetitive administrative tasks while maintaining accuracy

* Professional and trustworthy with confidential information

* Able to work during hours that overlap with California/U.S. Pacific Time



Preferred Qualifications



Experience in any of the following is a strong plus:



* Healthcare virtual assistant

* Medical virtual assistant

* Home health

* Physical therapy or occupational therapy

* Medical staffing/recruiting

* Healthcare credentialing

* Medical documentation

* Healthcare administration

* Remote staffing coordination

* Medical billing or payroll administration



Healthcare experience is preferred but not required for the right candidate.



Important Skills



The successful candidate should have strong:



* Organization

* Attention to detail

* Written English

* Communication

* Follow-up skills

* Time management

* Problem solving

* Spreadsheet skills

* Data entry accuracy

* Internet research skills

* Ability to prioritize tasks

* Ability to work independently



Work Environment



This is a 100% remote position.



You will work directly with the CCTP owner/management team in California. Because many of our therapists and agency partners operate during U.S. business hours, the candidate must be willing to work a schedule that provides meaningful overlap with Pacific Time (California).



Confidentiality



This position may involve access to confidential business and healthcare-related information. The successful candidate must maintain strict confidentiality and follow all applicable company policies regarding protected and sensitive information.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who can become a dependable part of our operations team — not simply someone who completes individual tasks.



The ideal person will eventually be able to take ownership of recurring responsibilities, recognize when something needs attention, follow up without being reminded, and help keep therapist staffing and administrative operations running smoothly.



If you are highly organized, proactive, dependable, and interested in building a long-term remote career with a growing U.S. healthcare company, we would love to hear from you.

title: Client Success Admin

Customer Success Admin (Remote, Philippines)

Company: Play Bigger Mentoring (Singapore)

Setup: Full-time, remote, Singapore business hours (same time zone as the Philippines)

Reports to: Operations Manager

Salary: PHP 90,000 to 110,000 per month



About us

Play Bigger Mentoring is a Singapore-based business advisory. Business owners come to us with different challenges: getting more leads, closing more sales, building a team. We help them overcome those challenges. Every client is assigned an account manager who guides them to results.



About the role

Our account managers focus on advising clients. You handle the admin that makes that advice turn into results, so nothing a client needs gets stuck or forgotten.



That covers areas like:

• Setting up client communication channels and access

• Onboarding and tracking each client's progress

• Day-to-day client follow-up

• Coordinating deliverables between clients and our team

• Client events, local and overseas

• Recruitment, for our own team and for clients who need to hire

• Reports, renewals and contracts



What you will do

Your job follows the client's journey: you get them set up, you keep things moving, and you remove whatever is slowing them down.

1. Set clients up and keep them moving

• Set up every new client after they sign: contract, Slack channel, software access, Google Drive folders, WhatsApp groups and tracking sheet.

• Check client chats daily and make sure no message goes unanswered.

• Coordinate work between clients and our team, such as landing pages, video shoots and ad campaign launches.

• Keep the client master sheet accurate, and present a weekly report on onboarding, pending items and upcoming renewals.

• Handle the admin for renewals and expiries.

2. Support the account managers and executive team

• Get out whatever the account managers and executive team need to serve clients: scheduling, follow-ups, reminders and chasing missing details.

• Plan the logistics for client events, local and overseas: venues, bookings, invites and reminders.

• Follow up with clients before each event so they show up and it runs well.

• Prepare contracts, tracking sheets and access before every event.

3. Hire when hiring is the bottleneck

• Recruit for our own team and for clients whose growth is held back by a missing hire. Most of these are remote roles.

title: Meta Ads Copywriter / Scriptwriter
description:

The scripts you write will speak to homeowners in the United States who may be considering a project or service from one of our clients. Your job is to understand each contractor's services, ideal customer, local market and approved offer, then turn that research into ads that catch the right homeowner's attention and encourage them to take the next step.

We're looking for a creative, resourceful Meta Ads Copywriter / Scriptwriter who can develop distinct angles, learn from results and keep a steady batch of fresh scripts ready for our team to produce.



PAY AND SCHEDULE



• Starting pay: $600 USD per month

• Schedule: Monday through Friday, six hours per day

• Type: Remote, part-time

• Your schedule must overlap with our team for assignments, feedback and brief calls. Exact hours will be agreed before hiring.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Create scripts for newly onboarded clients and variations for existing campaigns.

title: Founding AI SEO Strategist
description:
Most SEOs are still doing by hand what should have been automated a year ago. Writing one page at a time. Checking rankings one at a time. Responding to reviews one at a time. Meanwhile the game moved. AI can now do the grunt work of ten people, and a real operator uses that to bury the competition instead of keeping busy.



I'm hiring the person who already gets this.



I run these campaigns myself, so I know exactly what "good" looks like, and I'm going to be blunt about who I want. I want someone who builds the machine, not someone who does the reps. Someone who wires up AI to research, generate, publish, index, monitor, and report, then spends the time it frees up on the strategy that actually wins the map pack. Someone who's fluent in white hat, grey hat, and black hat, and cares about exactly one scoreboard: did the client end up dominating their local market or not.



If that's you, keep reading. If it's not, no hard feelings.



## Who we are



We're an established SEO agency helping local businesses rank at the top of Google. Mostly US home-service contractors (roofing, HVAC, cleaning, window cleaning), plus a handful of e-commerce brands. US-based, US clients. We already have the structure: documented SOPs, proven processes, and results that keep clients coming back. Every role here points at the same target, local domination, and this seat is the one that gets there with leverage instead of hours.



## The role



This is our founding AI SEO strategist seat. Your job is to take everything we do to rank and defend local clients and make it faster, bigger, and smarter using AI and automation. You're the first dedicated AI hire stepping into a machine that already works, not a mess you have to clean up. The systems produce. You make them produce at a scale a manual operator can't touch, and you own the shift to AI search before our clients even know it's happening.



I want someone who automates the boring parts, builds pipelines that run themselves, and frees us both up for the strategy that moves rankings. This is a long-term seat. I want someone I can grow with for years.



## What you'll own



- **Automating the grunt work.** You build pipelines that handle research, content generation, internal linking, publishing, indexing, monitoring, and reporting so nobody on the team does the same manual task twice. Comfortable with Claude and Claude Code, no-code tools like 
 and n8n, scraping, and wiring up APIs. If a process can run itself, you build it once instead of grinding it forever.

- **Programmatic local pages at scale.** City-by-service and service-area landing pages generated en masse, but with real per-page on-page optimization (title, H1, meta, schema, genuinely useful content), not thin URL spam that gets a client hit with a spam action. You know the difference, and you know why the second one gets someone deindexed.

- **GEO and AI search.** Getting clients cited and recommended across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Grok. You understand that AI citation is decoupled from ranking (roughly a third of LLM-cited pages have zero organic presence), that programmatic architecture plus FAQ schema can trigger citations faster than classic SEO, that entity density and clear brand-proof content are what get you pulled into answers, and that Reddit quietly shapes what these models say about a brand.

- **LLM citation auditing.** Tracking the exact prompts our clients need to win, seeing which brands get cited and why, mining the citation sources behind competitors' answers, and matching our content format to what actually gets cited (if every cited source is a listicle, we ship a listicle). Tools like Arvow, Semrush AI Visibility, and Ahrefs Brand Radar, or a pipeline you build yourself.

- **AI content with QA discipline.** You use AI to produce volume, but you're not a slop merchant. You anchor generation to briefs, you verify term and entity coverage instead of trusting a single optimization score, and you keep a human eye on brand and taste. Fast and good, not fast and garbage.

- **AI-assisted operations.** Review response drafting, rank and citation monitoring, technical-issue detection, competitor tracking, client reporting. If it's repetitive, you're looking for the automation.

- **Supporting the core local machine.** GBP optimization, review systems, citations, and the map-pack fundamentals still matter, and you understand them well enough to automate them intelligently rather than blindly.

- **Documentation.** Every pipeline and prompt you build becomes an SOP the next hire can run.



## Who you are



- **Native-level English.** You'll talk to me constantly and sometimes to clients. Non-negotiable.

- **An over-communicator.** This is the one I care about most. I want too many updates, not too few. When you build something that changes how we work, I want to hear about it.

- **A builder with no ego.** You hit a wall, you research it, you build your way out, then you tell me what you learned and hand me the tool. You'd rather ship an automation than complain about the manual task.

- **Fluent across the whole spectrum.** White hat, grey hat, and enough understanding of black hat to know exactly where the line is and why we don't drag client assets across it. You know the scaled tactics people use to game rankings and citations, and you know precisely which ones are worth it and which ones torch a real client's business. Judgment, not recklessness.

- **Obsessed with results.** Automation is a means, not the point. The point is the client owning their local market. If a beautiful pipeline isn't moving rankings, you kill it.

- **Always sharpening.** This part of the field changes monthly. The day you stop testing new models, tools, and tactics is the day you stop being useful here.



## What you've actually done



- **Built real SEO automations**, not just used a SaaS. You can show me a pipeline you wired together (content, publishing, monitoring, reporting, whatever) and explain what it saved and what broke along the way.

- **Ranked multiple local businesses** into the map pack and held them there. Local is our bread and butter. You knew the lever, you pulled it, the position moved.

- **Gotten a brand cited in an LLM**, or at minimum audited why a competitor gets cited and you don't, and had a plan to close the gap.

- **Tested your own strategies on your own properties.** White hat, grey hat, whatever taught you something. I want someone who's broken things and understood why, then rebuilt them smarter. Cookie-cutter operators need not apply.

- **Shipped fast with AI.** Spinning up sites, pages, and tools quickly using AI is second nature, not a stretch.

- **Expert in the core tools:** Semrush or Ahrefs, GSC, GA4, plus AI-visibility trackers. Bonus for BrightLocal, an indexer, and any automation stack.

- **Worked on a team before.** You know how to hand off, document, and collaborate.



## What I offer



- **Growth that's real.** As we add clients, the role grows and your pay grows with it. $2,000/mo to start, scaling toward $3,000+ as you take on more ownership, and higher over time as we grow together.

- **A real path to managing.** You're the founding AI hire. As the team grows, the right person becomes the one who runs it.

- **Real ownership.** No bureaucracy, no ten layers of approval. You own this here and you'll feel it.



## Logistics



- **Full-time, remote.**

- **Overlap with US business hours.** I need at least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time so we can collaborate in real time. Tell me your timezone and normal working hours.

- Start date: as soon as we find the right person.



## How to apply



Send me the following, and yes, I read every single one:



1. Your favorite vegetable and why. Put this at the very top of your application so I know you read the whole post. No vegetable, no reply.

2. Your name and age

3. What motivates you, be brutally honest. "Money" is a fine answer if it's the true one. I trust honest people more than polished ones.

4. Your SEO experience, and specifically how you use AI in it

5. The coolest thing you've ever automated or built with AI for SEO

6. One technical answer: a client ranks number one organically for their main service but never gets cited when someone asks ChatGPT for the best provider in their city. What do you check first, and what do you change?

Most people who call themselves local SEOs have never gotten a suspended profile back. They've never pulled a fake review. They've never reported a spammer off the map pack. They optimize a profile when it's healthy and disappear the second Google punches it in the face.



I'm hiring for the opposite of that person.

## Who we are



We're an established SEO agency helping local businesses rank at the top of Google. Mostly US home-service contractors (roofing, HVAC, cleaning, window cleaning), plus a handful of e-commerce brands. Google Business Profile is the center of gravity for almost everything we do, and it's where campaigns are won or lost.



## The role



This is our founding local SEO strategist seat. You own the Google Business Profile battlefield across our client base. Ranking profiles into the map pack, yes, but more importantly keeping them alive and clean when Google, competitors, and angry one-star reviewers come for them.



You're the first dedicated local hire stepping into a machine that already works, not a mess you have to clean up. The systems are built and they produce. Your job is to run them at a high level, own delivery, and make the systems themselves stronger, especially the reinstatement, review-defense, and spam-takedown playbooks that most agencies don't even have. This is a long-term seat. I want someone I can grow with for years.



## What you'll own



- **Suspension reinstatement.** When a profile gets suspended, you run the recovery. You know the difference between "suspended" and "not verified," you know to stack every piece of proof into the first appeal because you can't add more later, and you know the escalation ladder when the first appeal gets denied: second appeal, support forum with the ticket number and profile ID, live video verification call with a real Google rep. Getting a client back to live in days instead of the three weeks a generalist would burn is the whole job on a bad day.

- **Video verification and reverification.** You've passed it. You know what to do when the upload dies at 99 percent for the tenth time, and you know the documentation angle (state registration, DBA, business license matching the address, Secretary of State lookup) that gets a human reviewer to approve.

- **Review defense and removal.** You know Google's review content policy cold, so you can look at a review and call whether it's removable before you waste a flag on it. You report policy-violating and competitor reviews through the right channel, you coordinate the team to submit reports from multiple accounts when a review genuinely violates policy, and you appeal legitimate reviews that got wrongly filtered or removed back onto the profile instead of shrugging and chasing new ones.

- **Competitor spam takedowns.** Keyword-stuffed business names, fake addresses, lead-gen listings with no real location. You spot them and you report them through the Business Redressal Complaint Form. This is a sanctioned tactic, not black hat, and used well it clears the map pack of the exact fakes that are outranking our clients.

- **Duplicate listing cleanup.** Finding, merging, and recovering reviews off duplicate and lost listings without nuking the review count on the surviving profile.

- **Ranking the map pack.** Primary category strategy (the single biggest lever, and you know it), proximity and service-area logic, review velocity systems that build without tripping the filter, and the engagement signals that actually hold a position once you've won it.

- **Review generation systems** that run themselves: QR at the truck and the job-completion email, service-plus-location seeding in the ask, response cadence inside 12 to 24 hours, warmed-up sending so you don't torch deliverability on day one.

- **Citations and NAP hygiene** as a floor, not a monthly deliverable we pretend is moving the needle. You know the consistency threshold that matters and you know when to stop.

- **On-page and technical support** for the money pages the profile feeds: local landing pages, schema, internal linking, indexing new pages with a real indexer instead of praying to GSC.

- **Documentation.** Every play you run, you turn into an SOP the next hire can follow.



## Who you are



- **Native-level English.** You'll talk to me constantly and sometimes to clients. Non-negotiable.

- **An over-communicator.** This is the one I care about most. I want too many updates, not too few. When a profile goes down I want to hear it from you before I notice it myself.

- **Calm when Google isn't.** A suspension is a puzzle, not a panic. You work the process, you document what worked, you tell me what you learned.

- **Fluent across the whole spectrum.** White hat, grey hat, and enough understanding of black hat to know exactly where the line is and why we don't drag client assets across it. You know the shortcuts other people use to fake addresses, spoof verifications, and buy reviews, and you know precisely why we don't do those on a client's real business. Knowing the dark playbook is how you recognize it in a competitor and how you defend against it. Running it on a client's profile is how you get them wiped.

- **Always sharpening.** Google changes the reinstatement flow, the review policy, and the verification process constantly. The day you stop keeping up is the day you stop being useful here.



## What you've actually done



- **Reinstated a real suspended profile.** Not read about it. Done it. You can walk me through an actual recovery: what got it suspended, what you submitted, how long it took, and what you'd do differently. This is the single biggest thing I'm screening for.

- **Removed a review that violated policy**, and recovered a legitimate review that got wrongly filtered. You know both directions of the review fight.

- **Passed video verification** and handled the ugly edge cases (upload failures, reverification, home-address service-area profiles).

- **Expert in the core tools:** Semrush or Ahrefs, GSC, GA4, GBP itself, and bonus points for BrightLocal and an indexer.

- **Worked on a team before.** You know how to hand off, document, and collaborate.



## What I offer

- **A real path to managing.** You're the founding local hire. As the team grows, the right person becomes the one who runs it.

title: Part-Time Virtual Acquisition Manager — Florida Real Estate Wholesaling
description:
Essential Home Investors LLC is a Florida real estate investment and property management company buying single-family houses in St. Lucie, Brevard, and Polk counties. We are hiring a part-time remote Virtual Acquisition Manager based in the Philippines.



Schedule: Monday to Thursday, 2:00pm to 6:00pm Eastern Time, plus Saturday 10:00am to 2:00pm Eastern Time, 20 hours per week.

Pay: Negotiable, plus a flat bonus per closed deal (not a percentage of the assignment fee).



What you will do:

- Talk to already-qualified warm and Hot sellers passed on by our cold callers.

- Run comps and prepare ARV (after-repair value) and MAO (maximum allowable offer) drafts.

- Negotiate with sellers within an owner-approved offer range.

- Present offers and follow up until a contract is signed.

- Draft purchase paperwork for the owner to sign.



The owner keeps final pricing and signing.



Requirements:

- 2+ years of experience in real estate wholesaling acquisitions, with proof of closed deals.

- Fluent American English, spoken and written.

- Hands-on experience with PropStream, Podio, GoHighLevel, Mojo, CallTools, and/or ReadyMode.

- Strong negotiation, follow-up, and organization skills.

- Reliable internet, headset, and a quiet workspace.



How to apply - please include all of the following:

1. A 60-90 second voice recording of you introducing yourself and walking through a short example of how you would present an offer to a motivated seller.

2. A mock comp/ARV example for a single-family house (show your comparable sales, ARV, repair estimate, and MAO draft).

3. A short note about your wholesaling acquisitions experience, including proof of closed deals.

4. The dialers and CRMs you have actually used.

5. Answers to these screening questions:

   a. What are you looking for - a short-term project, a longer project, or a more stable long-term position?

   b. When could you start - are you available to start mid-December to beginning of January?

   c. How many hours per week can you commit to long-term, and is the 20 hrs/week part-time schedule (Mon-Thu 2-6pm + Sat 10am-2pm Eastern) workable for you?



Applications without the voice recording will not be considered.
salary: Negotiable + flat bonus per closed deal

title: DIY Fashion Brand Assistant (sewing and Adobe skills)
description:
Hi! I'm Isabelle and I have a DIY fashion brand = I sell clothing styles in the shape of PDF sewing patterns, for creative people who want to sew their own clothes. 



When people buy my products, they get:

1) a PDF sewing pattern.

2) a PDF instructions file with fabric recommendations, fabric yardage, body measurements... and sewing instructions which consist in text + sketches (20 pages).

3) a PDF file with the fabric yardage and cutting layouts (4 pages).

4) a video tutorial (basically, the instructions, but this time, in video).



I'm looking for someone who could make the steps 2, 3, 4. 



Required skills:

- you must know how to sew, about fabrics... and the sewing vocabulary in English. Topstitching, understitching, overlocker, right/wrong side of the fabric, interfacing... 

- Premiere Pro to make the video tutorial

- Illustrator to create the instructions sketches

- InDesign to create the PDF instructions and fabric layout files (using my template).

- you must be smart and have a great attention to details.



Estimated time needed: eventually (=after an adaptation/learning period), I could send 1-2 projects per month. One project would take 4-5 days.



I'm looking for someone to collaborate with on the long run. There would necessarily be a "training period" or a couple of training exercices, where you'd be adjusting to the tasks, there would be a lot of feedback.

title: Specialist VA and Personal Assistant (Full-Time, Australian Home Services Business)
description:
**Be the friendly, clear voice that helps people live their best life.**





An Australian home services business on the Gold Coast needs a full-time Specialist VA and Personal Assistant. You will be the owner's right hand and second in command. You will be the first voice many clients hear.





**What We Offer**





Full-time, long-term role: 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday

PHP 30,000 during probation

PHP 35,000 after probation

20 days paid annual leave

10 days paid sick leave

13th month pay

A warm, easy-going Australian owner who is direct and friendly

Low supervision and real ownership of your work

A local Australian colleague who trains you and works with you day to day

Room to grow into recruitment, compliance and payments after month one

Start as soon as possible

**What You'll Do**





Answer and make the business's calls (about 20 a day). Many callers are NDIS, DVA or aged care clients, so you need to be slow, clear and kind.

Manage bookings in ShiftCare and, later, a new booking system.

Confirm every booking by call or SMS the day before, and again each morning.

Plan travel between bookings and group nearby jobs on the same day.

Reschedule when staff are sick, keeping the same cleaner for each client where possible.

Call clients when staff are late or locked out.

Be the main contact for the field team, check timesheets and clock-ins, and be firm with staff who don't clock in.

Handle complaints and follow up unpaid invoices in a caring but firm way.

Sort and answer the owner's
.

Call or message the owner about five minutes before every appointment in her diary.

From month two: run recruitment and compliance tracking, prepare staff and contractor payments in Xero for approval, write social posts, and write policies and manuals.

Not part of the role: daily invoicing and managing people.





**Requirements**





Must-Have





Impeccable, clear, slow English with a soft, neutral accent. This is the most important requirement. A strong accent or fast speech will not work for this role.

Able to work 8am to 4pm Queensland time (6am to 2pm Philippines time), Monday to Friday

Takes initiative and does not wait to be told what to do

Good critical thinking and problem-solving, and able to make sound judgment calls when the owner is unavailable

Caring but firm: kind and patient with older and NDIS clients, and firm with difficult customers and staff

A "yep, sure, I'm on it" attitude

Reliable and trustworthy with confidential client, staff and personal information

Comfortable working mostly by
 with low supervision

Nice-to-Have





CRM experience and quick learning of new systems

ShiftCare or Xero experience (we will train you)

Call centre or phone customer service experience

Booking, rostering or travel planning experience

Care, NDIS or home services experience

Recruitment experience

**Schedule**





8am to 4pm Queensland time (6am to 2pm Philippines time), Monday to Friday. This is a fixed schedule.





**Is this you?**

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager



A right-arm role for a founder-led digital agency — part marketing manager, part coordinator, part executive assistant.

Detail

This role

Type Full-time, remote (overseas)

Pay US $1,800 per month, depending on experience

Hours Full-time, with substantial overlap with U.S. Pacific Time business hours

Reports to Rob Poling, business partner — leads Brandetize day to day

Works with

Rob, the internal team, and external tech and design resources

Apply to







About Brandetize

Brandetize is a digital agency that helps experts, coaches, authors, and membership businesses grow — through funnels, campaigns, content, and the systems behind them. It is founder-led and fast-moving, and the team works across several client brands at once, so priorities shift and no two days look the same.

That pace is exactly why this role exists. We are hiring a right hand for Rob, who leads Brandetize day to day: someone who understands marketing, thinks at a high level, and also gets things done.

About the role

Brandetize is looking for a resourceful, marketing-minded professional to work directly with Rob as a trusted right hand — helping turn ideas, conversations, and priorities into finished work.

This is a hybrid role, and that is the point. You are not a traditional executive assistant who only manages an inbox and a calendar, and you are not a marketing manager who only sets strategy and hands everything off. You do both — and you coordinate the work in between. You will understand the goal behind a project, help organize the plan, complete work yourself, and coordinate with designers, technical specialists, and other resources to keep everything moving.

On any given day you might join a call with Rob and turn it into a clear action list, draft campaign copy with the help of AI, check in with the tech and design team to keep a funnel build on track, build the slides for a presentation, and follow up on the three things that would otherwise have slipped.

Speed matters here. The person who thrives in this role communicates quickly, flags problems early — with a proposed solution — and would rather send a short update now than a perfect one tomorrow. You will work directly with Rob day to day, thinking with him, not just taking tasks from him.

What you'll do

Turn conversations into action

Join calls with Rob, clients, partners, and team members; understand the business context and capture decisions, priorities, owners, and deadlines.

Translate discussions into clear tasks, project plans, and recaps sent soon after each call — then follow through until every action item is done.

Prepare agendas, briefs, and background research before important meetings.

Anticipate what Rob needs next and bring recommendations, questions, and potential problems to his attention.

Act as a thought partner: share ideas, ask good questions, and push back respectfully when something will not work.

Marketing and funnels

Help plan, execute, and launch marketing campaigns,
 sequences, landing pages, offers, and funnels for Brandetize and its clients.

Work hands-on with funnels in GoHighLevel: build or update pages, forms,
 sequences, and workflows. Hands-on GoHighLevel experience is required for this role.

Review deliverables and QA funnels end to end before they go
 test links, forms, tags,
s, customer journeys, and payment flows.

Track campaign and funnel progress, spot where something has stalled or broken, and raise it before it becomes a problem.

Coordinate projects and people

Keep priorities, deadlines, and deliverables organized across several projects and client brands at once.

Manage the day-to-day work of external resources — including tech, development, and design teams — with clear briefs, confirmed deadlines, and timely follow-up.

Maintain a single, clear view of what is in progress, what is waiting, what is blocked, and what is next.

Keep Rob informed with concise updates on progress, decisions needed, and next steps.

Copy, content, and AI

Use AI tools daily — for example ChatGPT or Claude — to research, brainstorm, and draft copy, then edit it for accuracy, clarity, and brand voice so it sounds human and is ready to ship.

Draft
s, announcements, newsletters, landing-page and ad copy, and client-facing documents in clear, excellent written English.

Repurpose content and ideas across formats — for example turning call notes into an
, a brief, or a set of slides.

Slides, systems, and executive support

Build clean, branded slide decks, proposals, one-pagers, and documents for presentations, marketing initiatives, and client communications.

Create repeatable workflows, checklists, templates, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) so recurring work runs the same reliable way every time, and spot work that AI or automation can simplify.

Help manage Rob's commitments, meeting preparation, follow-ups, and day-to-day priorities, and draft professional
s to team members, clients, and partners.

Keep records, contacts, and customer relationship management (CRM) data clean and consistent, organize information, and pull simple reports and summaries when leadership needs a clear view.

Support onboarding and events as needed, and handle sensitive business information with discretion.

Skills and qualities we're looking for

Hands-on GoHighLevel experience is required. You do not need to be an expert in every other tool below on day one, but marketing fluency, organization, and communication speed are essential — they are the core of the job, not extras. We are looking for experience in marketing coordination, project management, executive support, business operations, or a similar hybrid role, ideally 3+ years, preferably at an agency or online business.

Area

What we need

Marketing understanding

You genuinely understand digital marketing — funnels, lead magnets, landing pages,
 campaigns, launches, offers, and the customer journey — and can talk about them at a high level, not just complete tasks inside them

Communication speed

Fast, clear communication during agreed working hours: you acknowledge requests promptly, communicate realistic timelines, and close the loop without being chased; excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to speak up on calls and ask thoughtful questions

Ownership

You take a goal, clarify what is needed, and run with it from idea to finished result with little direction — and you flag blockers early, with a proposed solution, instead of waiting

Coordination

Comfortable managing external tech, design, and freelance resources and holding deadlines kindly but firmly

Executive support

Experience supporting a senior leader or executive: joining calls, capturing decisions, and driving follow-through

AI tools

Confident, daily use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude for writing, research, planning, and productivity — with sound judgment about checking and improving its output

GoHighLevel and CRM

Required: hands-on GoHighLevel experience — building pages and funnels, forms, workflows, tags, pipelines, and
 and SMS sequences. Experience with other CRMs (for example HubSpot or ActiveCampaign) is a plus, but it does not substitute for GoHighLevel

Slides and documents

Can build polished slide decks and clear documents (Google Slides, PowerPoint, or Canva)

Organization

Strong organization and follow-through across several projects and stakeholders at once





Nice to have

Deeper GoHighLevel expertise — advanced workflows and automations, snapshots, and custom reporting.

Agency experience supporting several client brands at once.

Copywriting background, or a strong eye for persuasive copy.

 marketing experience: newsletters, broadcasts, and follow-up sequences.

No-code and automation tools such as Zapier or Make, and project management tools such as Asana, ClickUp, or Notion.

Google Sheets or Excel reporting, and basic HTML/CSS for small page edits and troubleshooting.

What success looks like

When

What success looks like

First 30 days

You know our clients, tools, and active projects. You are running call recaps and action-item follow-up for Rob, and calls consistently lead to clear next steps.

First 90 days

You own day-to-day coordination of our tech and design resources, you are building and launching funnel pieces with little direction, and marketing projects move forward with fewer reminders from Rob.

Long term

You are the person who keeps Brandetize's projects moving: copy, presentations, and other materials arrive organized and ready for review, potential problems surface early with proposed solutions, and Rob has more time to focus on relationships, strategy, and growing the business.





Who thrives in this role

You will love this job if you like variety, think like a marketer, enjoy thinking through a challenge and making useful recommendations, and get satisfaction from turning a messy conversation into a finished result. You will struggle in it if you need a narrow job description, a slow pace, or constant step-by-step direction. Above all, we are looking for someone resourceful, proactive, and genuinely curious about how the business — and each client's business — can run and grow better.

Role details

Detail





Type

Full-time, long-term

Location

Remote — overseas / international candidates welcome

Hours

Monday–Friday with substantial overlap with U.S. Pacific Time business hours, including live calls and responsive collaboration; the exact schedule will be agreed before hiring

Pay

US$1,800 per month, depending on experience and fit

Reports to

Rob Poling, business partner — leads Brandetize day to day

Equipment

Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a quiet space for video calls

Start

As soon as the right person is found





How to apply

 your application to 
 with the subject line “Right Hand – [Your Name]” so we know you read the full post. Please include:

Your résumé or LinkedIn profile, or a summary of relevant experience.

A brief note (one or two paragraphs) on why this combination of marketing, coordination, and executive support suits you.

A short example of a time you took a loosely defined idea, messy meeting, or stalled project and turned it into a completed result — what you did and what happened.

Two or three examples of work you personally contributed to — including at least one GoHighLevel funnel, workflow, or campaign you built or managed, plus for example an
 campaign, presentation, or project plan — and your role in each. Please remove any confidential information from work samples.

A sentence or two on how you use AI tools in your daily work, with a real example, and how you check the quality of its output.

A short 2–3 minute video or Loom introducing yourself, so we can hear how you communicate.

Your location, availability, and the working hours you can cover, expressed in U.S. Pacific Time.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a video interview and asked to complete a small paid test project: we will give you a recorded call and ask you to turn it into a recap, clear action items, and a first draft of one marketing asset — so we can both see whether the fit is right.

If you read this description and thought, “That is exactly how I already work,” we would especially like to hear from you.

title: Financial Operations Manager / Controller (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~10 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (~15 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location: Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: Immediately



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. 



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours

5:30 AM – 7:30 AM PHT (10:30 AM – 12:30 PM NZDT)



These hours are required each business day for core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Mondays), and communication with the New Zealand team.



Candidates should have some flexibility outside these hours to address urgent or time-sensitive matters, ensuring outstanding tasks are resolved before the following business day.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately ~15 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

• Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

title: Static Ads Creator
description:
The role



We’re a US-based e-commerce brand, and most of our sales come from
 and Instagram ads. We need a fast designer who understands what makes ads convert to design static image ads for our Black Friday and Cyber Monday campaigns. We’ll give you product photos, the offers and the angles. You turn them into scroll-stopping ads that sell. This is direct response design, not branding: every ad has one job, which is to get the click and the purchase.



What you’ll do



Design about 40–60 static ads over the campaign. At peak that’s roughly 5–8 ads per working day.

Make sizes for each placement: 1:1 (1080×1080), 4:5 (1080×1350) and 9:16 (1080×1920) for Stories and Reels.

Build several versions of each concept with different headlines, offer callouts, layouts and backgrounds so we can test what works.

Use formats that work for BFCM, such as:

Offer and discount callouts

Bundle and gift-angle ads

Before/after and us-vs-them comparisons

Feature callout diagrams

Review and testimonial graphics

Native-style and “ugly” ads

Countdown and “ends tonight” ads

Turn around revisions within 24 hours. During BFCM week, we need same-day turnaround.

Organize your finished files in a shared Google Drive folder using our naming convention.



Requirements



A portfolio of static ads for e-commerce or DTC brands. We need to see performance ads, not logos or social media posts.

Strong skills in Photoshop, Figma or Canva Pro. Using AI image tools like Midjourney or Photoshop Generative Fill is a big plus.

Good English, so you can read briefs and write or adjust short ad headlines.

An understanding of what makes an ad convert: clear hierarchy, one main message, a readable offer and a strong hook in the first second.

Fast, reliable and responsive during US business hours (Arizona time), especially Nov 24–Dec 1.

Steady internet, and available to start this week.



Nice to have



Experience with Black Friday / Cyber Monday or other holiday sale campaigns

Experience with physical product brands

Basic copywriting skills for headlines and offer text

Knowing Meta’s ad policies, such as avoiding misleading claims and before/after rules



Style expectations



We want clean, confident ads that make people feel urgency because of the deal, not because of fear or exaggerated claims. Keep all claims accurate: only use the product details we give you.



How to apply



Applications without all three of the items below will not be considered:



Resume

Portfolio link. It must include static ads you’ve designed for e-commerce or DTC brands.

Loom video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself. Please cover:

Your background and how long you’ve been designing ads

2–3 ads from your portfolio you’re proudest of, and why you think they performed well

Your availability (hours per week and start date)

Whether you prefer the hourly or the flat project rate



Start your application with the words “BFCM READY” so we know you read the whole post.



Shortlisted applicants will do a paid test: 3 static ads from a short brief, due within 24 hours. The best designer gets the role right away.

title: Graphic Designer & Illustrator
description:
Graphic Designer & Illustrator: Create Children's Books That Kids Love

Full-time



Love drawing? Want your art in the hands of children around the world? At 1000 Miles, you'll create the playful, detailed scenes that make our BSCOOL books so much fun to explore while working with a friendly international team.



Who we are

We're 1000 Miles, the team behind our own consumer brands. BSCOOL makes creative activity books that keep kids aged 4–12 busy for hours, and Pop Craze makes fun novelty socks and gifts. We design everything in-house, and our products sell on Amazon and Walmart in the US, UK, Canada and Germany, plus through distributors in 7 countries. Our home base is China, the heart of global product making. Our studio is in Yiwu, a modern, welcoming city famous for the world's biggest product marketplace, where ideas turn into real products fast.




 | See our brand: BSCOOL on Amazon



Your day-to-day

Create books from start to finish: moodboards, scenes, characters, outfits and interactive pages

Bring our established characters and signature style to life, keeping every page consistent with the BSCOOL look

Design book covers and packaging artwork

Prepare polished, print-ready files: layers, bleed, cut lines and sticker outlines

Use AI tools for image generation, editing and idea exploration to work faster and try more ideas

Work closely with our product development team and grow into sharing your own ideas to make every book better



You'll thrive here if you

Are honest, energetic and enjoy working with teammates

See feedback as a way to grow, and love learning new things

Work confidently in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop

Love to draw and can tell a story through composition and color

Enjoy a fast-paced team with real deadlines, and take pride in finishing great work

Speak basic conversational English



Extra sparkle (nice to have)

Experience illustrating children's books or activity books

Curiosity about AI tools such as image generation and AI editing

Packaging or product design experience

A strong sense of style and a portfolio with range

**Our characters, style guides and references are already built, and we'll train you on our process and tools. Your attitude and your willingness to learn matter most.



Why 1000 Miles

A team of 7 nationalities working together every day

AI tools as a real part of daily work

Your work reaches customers in 4 Amazon marketplaces

Fast decisions: good ideas get heard and used quickly

Room to grow as the company expands



Ready to apply?

Send to 



Your resume and portfolio (children's illustration or similar)

A short note: share one illustration you're proud of. What choices did you make, and why? Your note helps us get to know you.

title: Software Developer – Go & React (Remote)
description:
Description:



Build FinOps HQ, the client portal at the center of how Outsourced FinOps delivers accounting and financial operations to small and mid-sized businesses. If you write solid Go and React and care about getting financial data right, we’d like to hear from you.



The role at a glance



100% remote, full-time independent contractor, hired directly (no BPO)

Flexible schedule with a 4–5 hour overlap with US Eastern time, starting at 8 PM PH time

Work alongside another engineer and report to our CTO

This is an exclusive role: no other part-time or freelance work once hired



What you’ll build



FinOps HQ is used by both our team and our clients. It connects to the systems clients already run on (QuickBooks Online, CRMs, project management tools), organizes their financial and project data, and turns it into reporting, workflows and tools. Today that includes:



Client dashboards and financial reports

Integrations and sync jobs that keep client data accurate and in one place

Contract intake, change orders, project billing and month-end close

Budgets, cash flow forecasts and budget-to-actual reporting

Internal review and reconciliation workflows that cut manual work for our accountants



Coming next:



KPI and benchmark dashboards that non-developers can set up

More CRM, time-tracking and resource-planning integrations

Approval workflows for contracts, change orders and invoices

AI-assisted tools for catching anomalies and speeding up month-end close



Day to day, you will



Build features across the Go backend and the React/TypeScript frontend

Build and maintain integrations with QuickBooks Online, CRMs and other client systems

Write and review PostgreSQL migrations and queries safely against live financial data

Write tests (Go, Vitest, Playwright) and keep CI green

Review teammates’ pull requests



What you bring



Strong Go and PostgreSQL experience, including migrations and query performance

Solid React and TypeScript

Comfort with financial data where correctness matters: billing, invoices, accounting reports

Experience with third-party APIs and background jobs

Clear written English in pull requests and Slack



Nice to have: QuickBooks Online API, AWS (ECS), Supabase, Cloudflare



What you get



Competitive pay based on your experience

Guaranteed year-end bonus (modeled on 13th month pay), plus potential performance bonus

22 PTO credits a year covering vacation, sick leave and holidays

Annual performance-based increases

A long-term role with room to grow as the platform expands



About Outsourced FinOps



We’re a client accounting and financial operations firm. We give small and mid-sized businesses the infrastructure, expertise, processes and oversight to operate efficiently and scale, through four service lines: Accounting Ops, People Ops, Project Ops and Strategic Ops. Our values: Confess & Forgive. Be Effective Rather Than Busy. Operate with Discipline. Enjoy Merited Liberty. Keep Your Relationship with Work Healthy. Improve Continuously. Take Ownership.



How to apply



After you apply here,
 
 with the subject line “Go Developer – [your full name]”. We only review applications that include this
.



In the
:



Start with one line naming the Go project you’re proudest of and what you built in it.



Share a link to code you wrote: a GitHub profile, a pull request, or a code sample. If your work is all in private repositories, say so and describe one project instead.



Answer these three questions in 3–5 sentences each, from your own experience:

1. Describe a database migration you ran against live production data. What could have gone wrong, and what did you do about it?

2. Tell us about a third-party API integration that broke in production. How did you find the cause?

3. What’s a bug you shipped that involved money or financial data, and what did you change afterward?



We’re looking for specifics, not polish. Short, concrete answers beat long ones.

title: Business Funding Specialist (Full Time, Excellent English)
description:
ABOUT US

We are a fast-growing credit repair and business funding company that has helped 4,000+ clients. We are expanding our funding department and need an experienced, confident specialist to manage our funding clients from application to submission.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call new funding leads quickly and run booked qualification calls during US Eastern business hours

- Confirm application details and collect the client's credit report link and signed credit authorization

- Collect documents: bank statements, tax returns, personal financial statement, business debt schedule, licenses and operating agreements

- Use ChatGPT to prepare cash flow analyses, profit and loss statements and balance sheets from bank statements

- Spot red flags before we apply: no business bank account, documents that do not match, poor Secretary of State standing, and business credit issues on Nav or Dun & Bradstreet

- Prepare a one-page client summary with the recommended funding amount

- Call CDFI, SBA and other lenders to request line sheets and keep our lender criteria spreadsheet updated

- Send clients who do not qualify to our credit repair team

- Keep all notes, tags and pipeline stages updated in GoHighLevel



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken and written English. You will be on the phone with US business owners every day.

- 1+ year of experience in business funding (SBA, CDFI, lines of credit, term loans or revenue-based funding)

- Strong understanding of personal and business credit reports

- Comfortable using ChatGPT, a CRM (GoHighLevel preferred) and Google Sheets

- Organized, detail oriented and fast to respond

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace and a good headset

- Available during US Eastern business hours



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word FUNDING so we know you read the whole post.

2. Send a 2-minute voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why a business owner should get a line of credit before applying for business credit cards.

3. Tell us about your funding experience and the types of funding you have helped clients get.



Applications without the voice recording will not be reviewed.

title: Accounting Manager (US Client Accounting and Financial Review, Part-Time)
description:

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Accounting Manager to review bookkeeping, resolve accounting issues, supervise bookkeepers, and prepare accurate financials for tax preparation. You will report to our US-based Client Services & Tax Manager, who leads client relationships and tax coordination.



Key responsibilities

• Oversee monthly closes and review financial statements across an assigned client portfolio.

• Review bookkeepers' work, provide corrections, and coach staff.

• Prepare or review adjusting entries and supporting schedules.

• Resolve discrepancies involving bank accounts, loans, payroll, fixed assets, receivables, payables, and equity.

• Lead clean-up and catch-up bookkeeping projects, including QuickBooks Desktop to QuickBooks Online conversions.

• Prepare year-end accounting packages with reconciled balances, prior-year tie-outs, and clearly identified tax questions.

• Track deadlines, communicate outstanding issues, and improve accounting procedures.

Qualifications

• Five or more years of accounting experience, including at least three supporting US businesses.

• Experience in a US-focused accounting firm or outsourced accounting practice.

• Proven ability to review others' work and resolve accounting issues independently.

• Strong QuickBooks Online skills and working knowledge of QuickBooks Desktop.

• Strong Excel skills and clear written and spoken English.

• CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent qualification preferred.

• Reliable internet and a private workspace.



You will do well here if you get the facts before you decide, finish what you start, like building checklists and systems, and would rather say "this is not ready" than send something wrong.



Hours and compensation

To apply, please submit:

• A brief summary of your US accounting, financial review, and staff supervision experience.
