• Your expected hourly rate, available working hours, and earliest start date.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical accounting assessment and interview.

title: Brand & Creative Designer
description:
Brand & Creative Designer



Employment Type: Part-Time or Full-Time  

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote  

Location: Philippines 

Department: Marketing & Creative



About the Companies:

We operate two accounting brands serving growing businesses across North America, with annual revenues ranging from $2M to $50M.



**Firm Five** is a fractional accounting firm providing ongoing accounting and financial support to growing businesses. We focus on building strong client relationships and delivering personalized financial services.



**Baseline Accounting** is a project-based accounting firm specializing in system migrations, bookkeeping cleanups, and finance technology solutions that help businesses build accurate, organized, and AI-ready financial systems.



Both brands have distinct identities and audiences, and we're looking for a creative professional who can strengthen their visual presence while maintaining a consistent standard of quality.



About the Role:

We're looking for a talented Brand & Creative Designer with a strong artistic eye, a solid understanding of branding, and the ability to create polished, professional visuals.



You will take ownership of the visual identity of both brands across digital platforms, websites, social media, presentations, proposals, advertising materials, and video content.



This role goes beyond creating graphics. We're looking for someone who understands how design communicates a company's identity, builds credibility, and makes a business stand out.



You should have a strong sense of layout, typography, color, and composition, along with the creativity to suggest new visual approaches and content formats.



We want an artist with genuine design skills and creative judgment, not someone who simply relies on AI-generated templates.



Key Responsibilities

1. Brand Identity & Guidelines

- Develop and maintain brand guidelines for both companies, including logos, colors, typography, templates, photography, and icon styles.

- Ensure both brands maintain distinct visual identities while meeting consistent quality standards.

- Review public-facing designs to ensure brand consistency.

- Identify and recommend improvements to existing brand materials.



2. Social Media & Digital Branding

- Design and improve company social media pages, including LinkedIn banners, profile images, featured sections, and other visual elements.

- Establish a consistent visual system for social media content.

- Create branded graphics, carousels, and other digital marketing assets.

- Develop visual materials that communicate credibility while keeping the brands approachable and authentic.



3. Personal Branding

- Create branded LinkedIn banners, profile visuals, and featured section graphics for company leadership and team members.

- Ensure personal profiles align with the company's visual identity while maintaining an authentic and professional appearance.

- Develop visual assets for founder-led content and professional profiles.



4. Creative Asset Development

- Design social media graphics, carousels, and short-form video assets.

- Create advertising creatives for paid campaigns and landing pages.

- Develop sales presentations, proposal templates, one-pagers, and service sheets.

- Design website graphics and replace placeholder visuals where needed.

- Build reusable templates to improve design efficiency and consistency.



5. Video & Data Visualization

- Transform screenshots, financial data, numbers, and graphs into clear, engaging visuals.

- Create charts, callouts, lower thirds, and data overlays for video content.

- Prepare and export assets in different formats, including vertical, square, and widescreen.

- Organize and deliver completed visual assets for video production.



6. Creative Research & Ideas

- Recommend new creative concepts and visual formats for both brands.

- Research successful design trends, professional services brands, and SaaS companies.

- Suggest content formats such as client success stories, before-and-after visuals, team spotlights, educational carousels, and behind-the-scenes content.

- Recommend a monthly creative direction and mix of visual content for each brand.



What This Role Does Not Include:

- Copywriting: Written content and messaging will be provided by the team. Your responsibility is the visual presentation and creative direction.

- Publishing: Approved assets will be handed over to the designated team member responsible for scheduling and publishing.

- Video Editing: You will prepare the visual assets, while a separate video editor handles the final video production.

- Community Management: Responding to comments, messages, and inquiries is not part of this role.



Work Process

1. Receive a creative brief or propose a new visual concept.

2. Develop the design based on the established brand guidelines.

3. Submit the work for review and approval.

4. Incorporate feedback and complete revisions promptly.

5. Deliver final, properly labeled, and formatted assets to the appropriate team members.



Qualifications & Requirements

- At least 3 years of professional experience in brand design, graphic design, or a related creative field.

- A strong portfolio demonstrating branding, visual identity, and graphic design capabilities.

- Experience working with B2B companies, professional services, or established brands is highly preferred.

- Strong understanding of typography, layout, color theory, composition, and visual storytelling.

- Experience developing brand identities and maintaining brand consistency across multiple platforms.

- Experience designing personal branding materials, LinkedIn graphics, or founder-led content.

- Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

- Working knowledge of Canva for quick design templates and content production.

- Ability to turn raw data, screenshots, and financial information into professional visual presentations.

- Strong attention to detail and consistency.

- Excellent time management, communication, and organizational skills.

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and meet deadlines.

- Must have a reliable computer, stable internet connection, and a suitable work-from-home setup.



 Nice to Have

- Experience working with accounting, finance, legal, or SaaS companies.

- Knowledge of motion graphics and animated carousels.

- Website design experience using Hostinger, Webflow, WordPress, or similar platforms.

- Experience developing brand guidelines from scratch.



How to Apply

Interested applicants must submit the following:

1. An updated resume.

2. A link to their design portfolio.

3. Samples of previous branding, graphic design, or creative projects.

4. At least one example of how they helped improve or establish a company's visual identity.

5. Before-and-after samples, if available.

6. A brief explanation of their role and contributions to the submitted projects.



Applications without a portfolio or relevant work samples may not be considered.



Recruitment Process

Our selection process includes:

1. Portfolio Review: Evaluation of design quality, creativity, consistency, and overall visual skills.

2. Initial Interview: Discussion of professional experience, design approach, and previous projects.

3. Practical Assessment: A paid design exercise involving a personal LinkedIn banner, a video-ready data visualization, and creative content recommendations.

4. Technical Assessment: Verification of computer specifications, equipment, and work setup.

5. Reference Checks: Verification of professional experience, reliability, and previous work performance.



We value creativity, attention to detail, professionalism, and a strong commitment to quality. We're looking for someone who can bring fresh ideas and help build two recognizable, trusted brands.

title: Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist
description:
Growth Pathway to Sales Manager / Team Leader



Company: Staff Connect (on behalf of our client)

Location: Remote – Philippines-based

Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)



Compensation: Performance-based earning opportunity ranging from PHP 30,000 to PHP 100,000+ per month, depending on individual sales performance. This role offers a competitive compensation structure with commissions and performance incentives that reward high achievers.



Schedule: Rotating 10-hour shifts across AEST business hours, with approximately 3–4 shifts rostered per week.



Leave: One week paid leave per year.



About the Client



Our client is Australia's leading misfuelling specialist, providing nationwide roadside assistance to motorists who a
 put the wrong fuel in their vehicle.



Their team supports customers during stressful situations by delivering fast, professional, and empathetic service while coordinating technicians across Australia.



Staff Connect is partnering with the client to build and expand their offshore operations team in the Philippines, creating long-term career opportunities for motivated individuals with leadership potential.



The Opportunity

Inbound Sales & Dispatch Specialist

Career Progression to Sales Manager / Team Leader



This is a fast-paced, customer-focused sales role centred on converting inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings while delivering exceptional customer support.



You will manage inbound roadside assistance calls, coordinate technicians nationwide, and ensure urgent jobs are handled efficiently from start to finish.



This role is best suited to candidates with previous roadside assistance, emergency dispatch, towing, transport coordination, or high-volume dispatching experience, as the environment requires excellent multitasking skills, urgency, and confidence in managing time-sensitive situations.



Team members who consistently achieve strong sales results and operational excellence will have opportunities for career progression into leadership positions and may eventually help manage the offshore team.



Performance Expectations

Successful candidates will be expected to:



- Achieve a minimum of 35 confirmed jobs sold per month

- Maintain strong inbound conversion rates

- Deliver exceptional customer service under pressure

- Efficiently coordinate and manage live dispatch operations

- Accurately handle bookings, job updates, and technician coordination

- Maximise every inbound sales opportunity



This role is ideal for individuals who are confident in sales, highly organised, calm under pressure, and experienced in fast-paced dispatch environments.



Key Responsibilities

Inbound Sales & Customer Service

- Handle inbound calls from customers requiring urgent roadside assistance

- Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through confident communication and objection handling

- Deliver calm, empathetic, and professional customer support

- Collect deposits and accurately record booking information

- Meet or exceed individual sales targets and performance KPIs



Dispatch & Operations Coordination

- Coordinate technicians across Australia using dispatch and booking platforms

- Monitor live jobs and technician availability in real time

- Manage cases from initial enquiry through to completion

- Communicate with customers and technicians via phone, Slack, Gmail, and SMS

- Prioritise urgent and high-pressure jobs efficiently



Quality Control & Administration

- Review jobs daily to ensure accurate completion and closure

- Identify missed opportunities, incomplete bookings, or operational issues

- Maintain accurate records in GeoOp and Xero

- Ensure ETAs, notes, discounts, and call outcomes are properly logged

- Support operational compliance and workflow accuracy



Process Improvement & Team Support

- Assist with updating templates, documents, and operational processes

- Participate in Slack huddles, training sessions, and coaching

- Support escalated customer concerns when required

- Contribute ideas to improve dispatch efficiency and customer experience

- Be comfortable participating in video meetings and team collaboration



What We're Looking For

Essential Requirements

- Minimum two (2) years' experience in:

- Roadside assistance dispatch

- Emergency or high-volume dispatch environments

- Strong understanding of fast-paced roadside assistance workflows and urgent customer situations

- Experience coordinating mobile technicians and managing live jobs in real time

- Ability to confidently explain services and convert inbound enquiries into confirmed bookings

- Strong communication and objection-handling skills

- Excellent attention to detail when managing bookings, ETAs, and customer updates

- Calm, professional, and solutions-focused under pressure

- Comfortable supporting customers dealing with vehicle misfuelling i
, including fuel extraction, fuel replacement, and vehicle testing services

- Proficient in Google Workspace, Gmail, and web-based dispatch systems

- Comfortable using Slack and participating in online meetings and huddles

- Reliable work-from-home setup with a stable internet connection



Highly Regarded

- Previous experience in:

- Misfuelling or fuel recovery services

- Automotive roadside assistance

- Mechanical or vehicle service coordination

- Knowledge of Australian roads and geography

- Experience supporting Australian customers or operations

- Leadership, coaching, or team mentoring experience



What's in It for You

- Fully remote work-from-home opportunity

- Performance-based earning opportunity ranging from PHP 30,000 to PHP 120,000+ per month

- Commission and incentive structure that rewards strong sales performance

- Clear career progression pathway into leadership roles

- Ongoing training and professional development

- Opportunity to work with a growing international team

- Supportive and collaborative work environment

- Long-term career growth for high-performing team members

title: Loan Processor – Australian Car & Personal Loans (Asset Finance)
description:
Are you an experienced loan processor who knows the Australian finance market inside out, and you're ready to stop being "just another VA" and become a key part of a growing business?



Precious Capital Finance is a fast-growing Melbourne brokerage specialising in car loans, personal loans, working with 40+ lenders. We're expanding into home loans and building our core team. This is a long-term role for someone who wants to grow with us, not a short-term gig.



WHO YOU ARE

- You've processed loans for Australian brokers and you know how lenders think

- You spot a missing payslip, a wrong figure or an expired ID before anyone else does

- You don't wait to be told – you chase clients, chase lenders and keep deals moving

- You take pride in clean, complete files that get approved first time

- You communicate clearly and confidently in English, in writing and on the phone

- You want stability, recognition and a role that grows as the business grows



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own loan files from first enquiry to settlement

- Collect and check documents (payslips, bank statements, ID, visa documents)

- Prepare complete, lender-ready applications for broker review

- Follow up clients quickly and professionally so nothing stalls

- Chase lenders on conditions, approvals and settlements

- Keep our Salesforce-based CRM accurate and up to date

- Follow up new leads and book client appointments



WHAT MAKES YOU STAND OUT

- Car loan / asset finance experience with Australian lenders

- Experience with Salesforce, Illion bank statements, Equifax or lender portals

- Mortgage processing experience (a big plus as we launch home loans)



WHAT YOU GET

- AUD $700/month base salary

- Bonus for EVERY loan that settles – the more deals you move, the more you earn

- Full-time, permanent, Monday–Friday, weekends off if you want.

- Work directly with the business owner – your work will be seen and valued

- Real growth: the right person can grow into a senior processor / team lead role as we expand



THE PERSON WE DON'T WANT

- Someone juggling multiple clients or jobs

- Someone who needs constant reminders

- Someone who sends incomplete files and hopes for the best



If that's not you, keep reading.



HOURS

Full-time, Monday–Friday, 9am–6pm Melbourne time (6am–3pm Philippine time). Reliable internet and a quiet workspace are essential.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "PCF" (applications without it won't be read), then tell us:

1. How many years you've worked with Australian brokers, and which lenders you've used

2. Which CRM and systems you've worked with

3. The one thing you do that makes your loan files better than other processors'

4. Your internet speed and work setup



Shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

title: Creator Partnerships for Medal.tv
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



This is an ops role with an outreach front end. You source creators, sign them, walk them through onboarding and warm-up, keep them posting on schedule, and make sure they get paid, across several client campaigns at once. When a campaign needs 10 or more creators posting a video a day, you are the person who knows at any moment who posted, who did not, and who is stuck.



Everything runs through 
. The best fit here is a strong ops person who is also good with people: fast, accurate, organized, and fine with strategy changing mid-contract.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Research and discovery. Find creators on discovery platforms using filters like US-based, niche, and account performance, and check whether their existing content formats match what we are actually trying to produce. Also watch TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram directly for viral formats and rising talent.

- Outreach. First contact via DM,
, or 
, pitch the opportunity, and run the relationship from there.

- Negotiation. Most UGC creators land on one of two standard rates, so day to day this is simple. On micro-influencer campaigns you will negotiate real deals creator by creator: rates, deliverables, usage.

- Onboarding and warm-up. Guide creators through onboarding in 
, including our bot-guided flow. Review warm-up videos and confirm creators are warming their accounts correctly before they post campaign content.

- Content review. Check creator content in 
 against campaign requirements, including that every video uses the right campaign hashtag so it gets tracked. Flag what needs redoing and explain why.

- Posting ops and reporting. Keep daily posting on track across every active campaign and maintain clean reporting on who posted, who did not, and who needs a nudge. Current and accurate, not reconstructed at the end of the week.

- Creator support. Be the first line for creator questions and unblock people fast. Advice has to be right and it has to be quick, since a correct answer six hours late still costs us a post.

- Payments. Run creator payouts on payment platforms like Grade and track what has been paid against what is owed.

- Spreadsheets and process. Work in our existing Google Sheets templates: updating them, fixing errors, keeping campaign data clean. If you can make our sheets run better, even better.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Strong ops instincts. You hold a lot of moving pieces without dropping any and always know the current state of a campaign.

- You know creator ops language (CPM, base pay, tiered bonuses, caps, deliverables) or can pick it up fast.

- You understand how social platforms actually work: hashtags and tracking, algorithms, formats, why a short-form video lands.

- Comfortable in 
. Servers, roles, channels, threads, tickets, bots.

- Great written communicator. Casual is fine, formal is not required, but it has to be clear, quick, and obviously competent with both creators and the team.

- Software-native. You use a lot of apps, pick up new ones fast on mobile and web (a PC for desktop apps helps), notice UI and UX details, and can take clean screenshots to build walkthroughs that guide a creator through an app they have never opened.

- Comfortable in Google Sheets.

- Adaptable. We work with early-stage startups where strategy gets built as contracts progress.



NICE TO HAVE

- Creator ops, influencer marketing, talent management, or community management experience

- Experience running creator payouts or working with payment platforms

- Advanced Sheets skills (formulas, automation, Apps Script) and an eye for improving process

- Familiarity with our niches: gaming, mobile consumer apps, crypto and trading

- You have created or edited short-form content yourself



THE BAR



You should be able to walk the full creator lifecycle start to finish, from sourcing to outreach to rate agreement to 
 onboarding to warm-up to posting with the right hashtag to tracking to payout, and know where any given creator sits in it at any moment.

In a bustling world where time is as precious as your cargo, Xpede stands tall as an innovative courier company and hyperlocal mobile advertising, revolutionizing local logistics one swift delivery at a time. We understand that whether it’s a critical contract, a treasured parcel, or simply that charger you left at home, speed and trust are non-negotiable. That's why we're excited to announce our search for a dynamic Business Development Representative to join our forward-moving fleet. As an integral member of the Xpede family, you'll embark on a career that is as fulfilling as it is fast-paced. Your mission? To be the vital link between our trailblazing services and the local businesses and communities craving them.



Insightful & Dedicated: You aren't just selling a service; you're offering peace of mind in a digitalized package. Empathize with the entrepreneurs longing for speedy deliveries and the individuals in dire need of their personal items. By identifying and tailoring solutions to each client's unique delivery needs, your role becomes more than a transaction, it's a transformable experience for our customers.



Relationship Architect: Forge enduring partnerships by being the answer to logistical hurdles. It's not just about meeting prospective clients; it's about understanding their stories, listening to their concerns, and walking them through the Xpede journey. With every handshake and every successful deal, you adorn the Xpede brand with another layer of trust and reliability.



Result-Driven Strategist: Armed with a clear vision and an infectious zeal, chart new territories in the market. This is your stage to shine, to illustrate your prowess in turning leads into landmarks of success. Each closed sale is a testament to your dedication and a stepping stone towards collective growth, both for you and Xpede.

title: Senior E-commerce Project Manager & Team Lead (Philippines)
description:
Senior E-commerce Project Manager & Team Lead (Philippines)



Salary: USD 10.35 to 12.65 per hour, depending on experience (about USD 1,790 to 2,190 per month, full-time)

Hours: PH 13:00 to 22:00, Monday to Friday, all year. In the Netherlands that is 07:00 to 16:00 in summer time (end of March to end of October) and 06:00 to 15:00 in winter time. An afternoon and evening shift, not a graveyard shift.

Type: full-time, remote, long term

Benefits: 13th month bonus (pro rata), paid in the first week of December. HMO allowance of up to $75 per month, starting 4 months after your start date.



ABOUT VIBRIX

Vibrix is a Dutch brand for a healthy indoor climate. Our founder, Remco Lunshof, suffered from allergies and asthma for years. He tested air purifiers from the big brands, was not convinced, and in 2019 started Vibrix in Rijswijk (Netherlands) with one air purifier of his own. Johnny Ma joined as co-owner in 2023 and leads product development.



Today we sell air purifiers (PureFlow), dehumidifiers (DryFlow) and replacement filters to thousands of households through our own webshop, Bol and Amazon. We test every model ourselves before it goes on sale, customers get an answer from a real person every day, and we are rated 4.6 out of 5 on Trustpilot from more than 3,200 reviews. Our products are made by partner factories in China, and we now receive full 40HQ containers every month.



Our mission: healthy air in every home, in every season. We want to grow from the Netherlands and Belgium to more European countries, and over the next 12 to 18 months we are building a team of experienced people, most of them in the Philippines.



See who we are on our website: vibrix . nl (type it without the spaces)



You will work directly with the owners, Remco and Johnny, and with Melvin (People & Talent).



THE ROLE

You are the first lead of our Philippine team and the project manager of our operation. You are responsible for the whole team.



We are hiring four senior roles at the same time: you, a Senior Supply Chain & Demand Planner, a Senior Amazon Marketplace Manager and a Senior Creative Strategist. You are involved in hiring from the start: you help select the candidates and join the interviews.



In your first 90 days you will:

• Own our project board: every task has one owner and a deadline, and you follow up until it is done.

• Follow up with every team member: work done on time and done well, feedback, and step in when something gets stuck.

• Help select the next hires: review applications, join interviews, give your advice.

• Set up a weekly rhythm for the team: one scorecard per role, one weekly call, a daily end-of-day update.

• Write down how the work is done (SOPs), so every new hire can start without someone sitting next to them.

• Take over day-to-day operational work from the owners, so they can focus on product and market.



After a year, success looks like this:

• Every role has a weekly scorecard and the team runs on it.

• Every process and every outside agency has one clear owner.

• No more than 2 issues per week end up with the owners.



WHAT WE ASK

• At least 3 years of proven experience in this role, at one or more comparable companies of the same size or bigger.

• At least 3 years leading a team of 5 or more people.

• You have hired at least 5 people yourself: you ran the selection and made or shared the final decision.

• You will write the SOPs yourself. In your application, share one work instruction (SOP) that you wrote yourself and that a team actually used in its daily work. Tell us who used it and for what.

• In-house or agency experience, not only freelance or task-based work.

• This is your only job.

• Certificate of Employment from your last two employers. We check your years of experience with it.

• At least 15 Mbps download speed, measured on the computer and at the place you will work from. The form asks for the link to your speedtest.net result.

• A laptop with 8 GB RAM and a good headset.



Nice to have: at least 3 years of experience in e-commerce, and experience with Monday, Asana or ClickUp.



We are looking for someone who knows more than we do about building and running a team. You learn fast, figure things out yourself and want to grow with the company.



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT

• Not a VA or task-based role.

• Not a manager who only delegates. In the first months you do a large part of the work yourself.

• Not a graveyard shift.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Apply ONLY through our application form. Messages and applications through the OnlineJobs.ph system will not be read.

2. Form: type this in your browser without the spaces: docs . google . com / forms / d / e / 1FAIpQLSeegzhPOeM--zbVyDOCR2ejxc5LmIHyBjo4ngACx6PCDVKdOQ / viewform

3. When applying, use 10 Apply Points.

title: HR Specialist - Clinical Marketing Agency - Remote
description:
## About CGA



We're a performance marketing agency for cash-pay healthcare clinics. We run patient acquisition for chiropractic, neurofeedback, functional medicine, HBOT, and aesthetic practices across the US. 65 active clients. Profitable, growing, and intentionally building a small team of high performers.



We're scaling from roughly 15 people toward 25 to 30. Founded 2019. Headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin.



## Our Core Values



These are not posters. They are how we d
. You will screen every candidate against them, so you need to believe in them yourself.



1. **Put the Patient First.** MRR and CPL are the scoreboard. A person in need reaching a provider is the game.

2. **Own the Result.** Outcomes, not effort. Never hand over a problem with nothing attached.

3. **Be Direct.** Say the hard thing while it is still cheap to fix.

4. **Be Disciplined.** Do the work on the days you do not feel like it.

5. **Improve Something Every Day.** Today's version of the work, and of you, can be beaten.

6. **Move Fast and Own Failures.** Fail cheap, own it with zero spin, fix it the same day.

7. **Build Systems, Not Dependence.** If only you can do it, you have not finished it.

8. **Put the Team First.** Cover the gap, share the credit, bring energy.



## About This Role



**Fluent, natural English is a hard requirement for this seat.** Every candidate you interview is based in the US. They hear your voice on every call, and leadership reads your written screens, your notes, and your outreach. If English is not effortless for you, spoken and written, this is not your role and we will catch it in the first interview.



Right now when someone leaves, our founders stop what they're doing and go recruit. Sourcing, screening, first-round calls, chasing candidates. That's weeks of executive time and a seat sitting empty the entire time.



You exist so that never happens again.



Your job is to keep a warm bench of pre-interviewed A-players for every seat we run. When someone resigns, we don't start a search. We call three people you already vetted.



This is not a job-posting-and-waiting role. You source, you screen, you interview, and you keep the bench stocked whether or not a seat is open today. Most of the people you interview will not get hired this month. That's the design. You're building inventory, not filling a req.



**This role requires direct experience recruiting for a marketing agency.** Agency seats do not hire like corporate seats. A media buyer, a commission closer, and a video editor each need a different filter, and the people who are great at them rarely look great on paper the same way. We will sharpen your filter. We will not build it from scratch.



You own this function end to end: sourcing, outreach, screening, interviewing, pipeline, reporting. You work directly with leadership. There is no HR manager above you.



## You Screen For Five Different Seats



This is the part most recruiters underestimate. You are not filling one kind of role over and over. You run a bench across five distinct seats, and the filter is different for each one.



**Client Success Manager.** You're testing for retention instinct and calm under pressure. Can they hold a hard conversation with an unhappy clinic owner without caving or getting defensive? Do they read data and translate it into plain language a doctor understands?



**Media Buyer.** You're testing for technical depth and judgment, not platform vocabulary. Ask for specific accounts, specific spend, specific CPA movement, and what they did when performance dropped. Anyone can say "Meta Ads Manager." Few can walk you through a real account they turned around.



**Video Editor.** You're testing on the work, not the resume. Portfolio first, then pace, revision tolerance, and whether they can match an existing style instead of imposing their own.



**Sales Setter.** You're testing for phone presence, resilience, and tonality. This one is best screened live. Can they handle a cold objection on the call with you without folding? Volume rejection is the job, so you're looking for someone who doesn't flinch.



**Closer.** You're testing for discovery skill and real numbers. Close rates, average deal size, how they handle price resistance. You want evidence they diagnose before they pitch.



Almost every candidate you interview is US-based, and most are in sales seats. You need to read American communication norms well enough to tell confidence from arrogance and polish from rehearsal. We'll test for this in your interview.



We'll calibrate you on all five seats in your first two weeks: the scorecards, the questions that actually separate real from rehearsed, and what we've learned from the hires that worked and the ones that didn't. After that, you own the filter.



**You need direct experience hiring for these seats, or seats like them at another agency.** We'll sharpen your filter. We won't build it from scratch. If your recruiting background is corporate roles, technical roles, or one function repeated, this seat will break you by week three.



## What You'll Actually Do



### Sourcing and Outreach



- Source through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and industry communities. Active outbound every single day.

- Build the lists, send the messages, work the follow-up

- Personally handle high-value outreach. The A-player who isn't looking doesn't respond to a template.

- Test channels and report what produces hires, not what produces applications



**The interview minimum is the floor of this job: 3 qualified first-round interviews per week for every active role, and 1 per week for every non-active role on the bench.** The exception is a seat we can fill fast from scratch, and we'll tell you which ones those are. You hit this whether or not anyone has resigned.



- Review Typeform applications and Loom submissions, and kill the weak ones fast

- Score every candidate against that role's scorecard and against our core values

- Run first-rounds solo. We calibrate you in your first two weeks, then you own the filter.

- Surface only candidates worth leadership's time. Leadership spends 30 minutes on a strong person, not 3 hours filtering.



### Interviewing and Screening



### Bench Management and Candidate Experience



- Maintain a live bench of at least 3 interviewed, scored, ready-to-call candidates for every active role, and at least 1 for every non-active role

- Nobody goes dark. Every person in the pipeline knows where they stand.

- Keep the tracker clean: every candidate logged, scored, with a visible next step

- Stay in contact with bench candidates so they pick up when a seat opens

- Write rejections people respect. Everyone we decline is a future referral source or a future client.



### Reporting and Process Improvement



- Weekly pipeline report: bench depth by role, interviews run, channel performance, bottlenecks

- Flag problems with the 1-3-1: one problem, three solutions, the one you recommend

- Improve the screening questions, the outreach templates, the scorecards. You don't wait for permission.



## The Deliverable Bar



**Every week:**



- **3 qualified first-round interviews per active role**

- **1 qualified first-round interview per non-active role**, unless it's a seat we can fill fast from scratch

- Daily outbound sourcing activity

- Weekly pipeline report delivered, complete and actionable

- Tracker current, no candidate without a next step



**Every month:**



- **Bench at 3 or more ready-to-call candidates per active role**

- **Bench at 1 or more ready-to-call candidate per non-active role**

- Zero open roles sitting without qualified candidates in motion

- Zero candidates gone dark



A qualified interview means: cleared the Typeform and Loom screen, has role-relevant experience with numbers attached, and you would put them in front of leadership today.



We pull one interview recording at random each week. Padding the number to hit the number is the fastest way out of this seat.



## The Screening Filter



You're the first real gate. You're filtering for evidence, not vibes.



**Move forward:**



- Demonstrated experience in the role category with numbers attached

- Career progression that makes sense

- Clear communication, written and spoken

- Specific accomplishments, not generic skills-speak

- Evidence they actually read the job description

- Ownership language. "I built." "I missed." "I fixed." Not "we" and "they."



**Kill fast:**



- Generic applications with copy-paste energy

- Vague claims with zero proof

- Frequent short tenures with no explanation

- No measurable accomplishments anywhere

- Victim mentality. Every bad outcome was someone else's fault.

- Entitlement. They lead with what they want before they show what they do.



**Gray area, move to interview:**



- Right skills, slight experience gap

- Unclear career story but strong accomplishments

- Recent transition with relevant background



Rule of thumb: if you're unsure, interview them. The interview answers ambiguity. If it's a clear no, kill it fast and kill it warm.



## Compensation



**Base:** $2,500/month, paid monthly via invoice.



**90-Day Retention Bonus: $400 per hire.** Paid when someone you sourced and screened reaches 90 days and hits their performance milestones.



**On-target earnings: $32,000 to $34,000 annually. We expect to fill 10 seats a year at most.**



The bonus pays on one thing: the people you place are still here and performing at 90 days. Nothing else.



We don't pay for bodies through the door and we don't pay for speed. If you push someone through who washes out at day 60, you lose the money and we lose the seat. That math should shape every candidate you advance.



## Who You Are



- You've recruited before and you can show your work: roles filled, how you sourced them, whether they lasted

- You've hired agency people before. Sales, media buying, creative, and client-facing seats all live on your bench, and you've filled them for real.

- You've interviewed US-based candidates and can read American communication norms

- You have real interviewing instincts. You know which questions separate the genuine article from a well-rehearsed resume.

- You're relentless on sourcing. Outbound is the job, not the backup plan.

- You're comfortable interviewing people for seats that aren't open yet, and you stay in touch well enough that they pick up when one does

- You're organized and fast. Five role categories, dozens of candidates, nothing dropped.

- You communicate warmly and professionally. Your rejection
s don't suck.

- You're coachable. We'll say "tighten your screen" or "move faster." The right answer is "done, here's what I changed."

- You respect the bar. You don't sneak weak candidates through to look productive.



## Hard Requirements



- Location is open. We screen on English, timezone overlap, and track record, not country.

- Fluent, natural English, spoken and written. This is the single hardest requirement in the posting. You are on video with US candidates all day and your written screens go straight to leadership. A heavy accent is fine. Hesitation, grammar errors, or candidates asking you to repeat yourself is not.

- Live overlap with US Central Time sufficient to interview US-based candidates and sync with our team

- **Direct experience recruiting for a marketing agency, or for the seats agencies run: client success, media buying, paid social, commission sales, creative production.** This is a hard filter. We are not teaching you what a strong media buyer or a strong closer looks like from zero.

- Recruiting, talent acquisition, or hiring operations experience with proof attached

- Reliable internet, quiet space, working camera. You're on video all day.

- Comfortable with recruiting tools: LinkedIn (Recruiter a plus), an ATS or Airtable-style tracker, Google Workspace, Loom, Zoom, Calendly. You don't need to be an expert on day one. You need to pick things up fast.

- You run first-rounds solo by week two



## Who This Isn't For



- Your recruiting experience is all corporate, technical, or one repeated function. We need someone who has hired agency people.

- You post jobs and wait. Sourcing is the majority of this role.

- You only like interviewing for open seats. Most of your interviews feed a bench.

- You go quiet on candidates the moment there's no offer to dangle.

- You pass people through to look busy. A washout at day 60 costs you money here.

- You can't say no. Our bar is real. Your job is to enforce it warmly, not erode it.

- You go quiet when something stalls instead of flagging it with a fix.

- You get defensive about feedback.

- You're uncomfortable being measured. This role is measurable by design. That's the feature.

- You want to be a talent strategist. You're an operator who sources, screens, and moves people.

- You need a hiring manager on every first-round call.



## What We Offer Beyond Comp



**You build the engine.** The channels, the filter, the templates, the bench you create become the standard as we double the team.



**Direct founder relationship.** You work with leadership and see how hiring decisions actually get made.



**High leverage.** One person's judgment compounds across every seat in the company.



**Control over your process.** See a better way to source or screen? Implement it.



**Room to grow.** As we scale past 30, this role grows into owning the full people function: onboarding, 30/60/90 tracking, performance cadence.



## What Success Looks Like



**Month 1:**



- Calibrate with leadership on what strong looks like for all five role categories

- Audit the current pipeline and every active posting

- Run your first solo first-rounds by week two

- Stand up the tracker: every candidate logged, scored, decision path visible

- Build the weekly report template

- Start daily outbound on the two highest-priority categories



**Months 2 to 3:**



- Hit the weekly interview minimum across every active and non-active role

- Bench at 3 or more per active role, 1 or more per non-active role

- Know which channels produce hires and reallocate effort

- First placements made and tracked to their 30-day marks



**Ongoing:**



- A seat opens and we fill it fast because the people were already warm

- Improve conversion month over month: outreach to reply, reply to interview, interview to bench

- Your hires reach 90 days and hit their milestones

- Founders never touch recruiting again



## How to Apply



DO NOT APPLY THROUGH ONLINEJOBS.PH - Apply Below. 



Apply here: 



The application includes a short video submission and questions about your sourcing and interviewing process. Name the agency-side roles you've personally filled and tell us how many of those people were still in the seat at 90 days.



Incomplete applications are not reviewed.



### Quick Facts



- **Company:** Clinic Growth Accelerator

- **Founded:** 2019

- **Founders:** Nick Urso (COO), Jeff Van Kampen (CRO)

- **Headquarters:** Milwaukee, Wisconsin

- **Work Mode:** Fully remote, offshore

- **Contract Type:** Independent Contractor, full-time

- **Hiring Timeline:** 1 to 2 weeks from application to contract



## Final Thought



One wrong hire in a 15-person company is 7% of the team, and the damage doesn't stay in their lane. One empty seat for six weeks is worse.



Right now our founders are still doing recruiting. That's time not spent on strategy, clients, or building the business. You absorb all of it.



If you're good, a resignation stops being a fire drill. It becomes a phone call to someone you already vetted.



That's the win, and that's what we pay for. If you want to build a talent engine for a fast-moving company, apply and show us your work.

Hours: PH 13:00 to 22:00, Monday to Friday, all year. In the Netherlands that is 07:00 to 16:00 in summer time (end of March to end of October) and 06:00 to 15:00 in winter time. An afternoon and evening shift, not a graveyard shift.

Type: full-time, remote, long term

Benefits: 13th month bonus (pro rata), paid in the first week of December. HMO allowance of up to $75 per month, starting 4 months after your start date.



ABOUT VIBRIX

Vibrix is a Dutch brand for a healthy indoor climate. Our founder, Remco Lunshof, suffered from allergies and asthma for years. He tested air purifiers from the big brands, was not convinced, and in 2019 started Vibrix in Rijswijk (Netherlands) with one air purifier of his own. Johnny Ma joined as co-owner in 2023 and leads product development.



Today we sell air purifiers (PureFlow), dehumidifiers (DryFlow) and replacement filters to thousands of households through our own webshop, Bol and Amazon. We test every model ourselves before it goes on sale, customers get an answer from a real person every day, and we are rated 4.6 out of 5 on Trustpilot from more than 3,200 reviews. Our products are made by partner factories in China, and we now receive full 40HQ containers every month.



Our mission: healthy air in every home, in every season. We want to grow from the Netherlands and Belgium to more European countries, and over the next 12 to 18 months we are building a team of experienced people, most of them in the Philippines.



See who we are on our website: vibrix . nl (type it without the spaces)



You will work directly with the owners, Remco and Johnny, and with our new Team Lead.



THE ROLE

You own the question: which ads do we make next, and why? You turn customer insights and ad data into new ad concepts, write the briefs, and make sure every test teaches us something.



In your first 90 days you will:

• Review our current ads and customer reviews, and write down what works and what does not.

• Set up a weekly creative testing rhythm: new concepts, clear hypotheses, one report per week.

• Write briefs for UGC creators, designers and video editors, and give feedback until the ad is right.

• Build a library of hooks, angles and winning ads, so the team can see what we learned.



After a year, success looks like this:

• New ad concepts go live every week, each with a clear brief and hypothesis.

• Every test has a result in the weekly report, and the next concepts are based on it.

• We have a set of winning ads per product and per market that we can scale.



WHAT WE ASK

Kaipar Clothing is a golf apparel brand specializing in premium performance clothing inspired by the spirit of aloha. Our designs combine Hawaiian-inspired artwork, tropical patterns, vibrant colors, and modern styling with comfortable, high-performance golf apparel.



Our goal is to create unique, stylish golf clothing that stands out both on and off the course. We are looking to expand our creative team with talented designers who can help us develop original artwork and patterns for future apparel collections.

 to familiarize themselves with our products, design style, and brand identity.

The ideal candidate has a strong artistic background and can create unique illustrations, seamless repeating patterns, textile prints, and surface designs using Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, or Procreate.

* Healthcare clinics

* Community organizations

* Other healthcare professionals

ing healthcare offices

*

* Location

Projects may involve:



* Google Ads

* Google Business Profile

* Psychology Today

* Zocdoc

* Insurance directories

* Website landing pages

*
 campaigns

* Review-generation strategies

* Provider launches

* Referral campaigns

* Social media campaigns

* Patient acquisition tracking

However, you should understand digital marketing and be comfortable learning new platforms.



Google Ads experience is strongly preferred but not required.



5. NETWORKING & COMMUNITY OUTREACH



Help us identify and coordinate opportunities for Ravora Health to build relationships in the community.



Examples may include:



* Healthcare networking events

* Therapist networking events

* Mental health events

* Health fairs

* Chamber of Commerce events

* Local business networking events

* College events

* Community events

* Ravora-hosted networking events



Responsibilities may include:



* Finding opportunities

* Contacting event organizers

* Gathering pricing and participation information

* Coordinating registration

* Maintaining an event calendar

* Helping prepare marketing materials

* Tracking contacts made

* Following up after events



6. MARKETING PROJECTS



You will regularly receive projects directly from Ravora Health leadership.



Examples:



"Find therapy practices in our target area that could become referral partners."



"Research PCP offices that accept the same insurance plans we accept."



"Create a system for tracking our referral relationships."



"Find networking events Ravora should attend over the next three months."



"Help us launch and market a new provider."



"Research why a particular marketing channel isn't generating enough patients."



"Find new ways we can acquire patients locally."



We are looking for someone who does not need every project broken down into individual instructions.



You should be comfortable researching, asking good questions, creating a plan, and taking ownership of execution.



AI & TECHNOLOGY

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

RAVORA GROWTH

 which organizations to prioritize

Philippines-based, independent contractor, full-time (40 hrs/week; hours may flex), $6-$8 USD/hr depending on experience. Mon–Fri with overlap 7am–7pm EST. TimeProof time tracking required.



About Murray Marketing Services



Murray Marketing Services is a growing U.S.-based digital marketing agency founded in 2021. We work primarily with service-based businesses throughout the United States and provide services including Google Ads, Meta Ads, website design, landing pages, SEO,
 marketing, CRM/automation, and conversion tracking.



We have a small remote team and are looking for a full-time GoHighLevel & Conversion Tracking Specialist based in the Philippines. You will support our Digital Marketing Support Specialist and take specialized technical work off his plate. This is not a replacement for that role — you will work alongside our Digital Marketing Support Specialist and own the deeper GoHighLevel, conversion tracking, integration, and reporting work.



This is a hands-on technical role. When a client is set up, you make sure everything behind the scenes is built, connected, tested, and tracking correctly. When something breaks, you find it and fix it. You will also write a setup doc for each client.



You will receive training, Loom tutorials, and SOPs for many of our processes, but we are looking for someone who already has strong GoHighLevel and conversion-tracking experience and can begin contributing quickly.



Core Responsibilities

These are the priorities for this role, in order.



1. Expert GoHighLevel Work (Priority #1)



Build and configure GoHighLevel subaccounts, snapshots, forms, calendars, pipelines, workflows, and booking setups

Handle GHL break-fix and CRM work when something stops working



Provide ongoing GoHighLevel support for our client Storage Caves, including builds, troubleshooting, and day-to-day GHL maintenance



2. Advanced Conversion Tracking (Priority #2)



Set up and maintain Meta Conversions API, Google Tag Manager, and GA4



Build and troubleshoot WhatConverts, offline conversions, and custom conversions



Set up and maintain Google Merchant Center tracking and related conversion setups



Test tracking after every setup or change, and fix broken, missing, or duplicate conversions



3. Zapier Integrations



Build, maintain, and troubleshoot Zapier integrations between GoHighLevel, tracking tools, and other client or internal platforms



4. AgencyAnalytics Dashboards & Report Builds



Build and maintain AgencyAnalytics dashboards and reports



Make sure dashboards are connected correctly and displaying accurate data



5. Claude and AI Tools



Use Claude and other AI tools to troubleshoot, document, and work more efficiently



Follow our processes for using AI tools carefully around live client accounts



6. End-to-End Testing, QA & Client Setup Documentation



Test every relevant form, workflow, integration, and conversion end to end before calling the work done



Write and maintain a clear technical setup doc for each client



Backup Duties (Not Core)

These are not the focus of the role, but you may be asked to help with them as backup support:



-
 and SMS automation

- Ad disapprovals and billing issues

- Simple tracking setup

- Lead form mapping

- A2P registration backup



What This Position Is NOT

You will not be responsible for:



- Ad strategy or optimization

- Media buying

- Client relationships or client calls

- Adding clients to ad accounts

- Website go-live, DNS/domain go-live work, or building websites from scratch

- Graphic design or video



We have specialists responsible for those areas. Your job is to support Bryan and the rest of the team by owning GoHighLevel, advanced tracking, integrations, reporting dashboards, testing, and documentation.



Requirements



- 2+ years of hands-on technical marketing experience at an agency or across multiple client accounts

- Expert-level GoHighLevel experience (builds, workflows, calendars, forms, snapshots, CRM, and break-fix)

- Practical experience with Meta Conversions API, Google Tag Manager, GA4, and advanced conversion tracking

- Experience with WhatConverts, Zapier, and AgencyAnalytics (or very similar tools, with a clear ability to ramp quickly)

- Comfortable using Claude and other AI tools to troubleshoot and work efficiently

- Strong written English and high attention to detail — you test your work before calling it done

- Able to manage tasks across many client accounts; reliable internet and computer

- A "figure it out" mindset, but no risky changes to live accounts without asking

- TimeProof time tracking is required



Valuable tools



GoHighLevel, Meta CAPI, GTM, GA4, WhatConverts, Zapier, AgencyAnalytics, Google Merchant Center, Claude, CallRail, Microsoft Clarity, Google Search Console, Make, Asana.



Hours & Compensation



• Rate: $6-$8 USD/hour, depending on experience

• Hours: Steady state is about 25+ hours per week. Hours may flex based on client work and launch volume.

• This is an independent contractor position.

• There is potential for additional hours, increased responsibility, and compensation increases as you grow in the position and as Murray Marketing Services continues to grow.

• The schedule is flexible, although we require regular availability Monday through Friday and some working-hour overlap with our U.S.-based team. Typically sometime between 7 am and 7 pm EST.

• TimeProof time tracking is required.



How to Apply



Please send:



- Your resume

- A short Loom introduction about yourself, why you're interested in this role specifically, and your GoHighLevel and tracking experience (REQUIRED)

- Examples / portfolio of relevant work (GHL builds, tracking setups, Zapier integrations, dashboards, or documentation)

- The word "MURRAY" at the top of your application so we know you read this.



And please answer the following questions (either written or via Loom):



1. Tell us about a GoHighLevel break-fix you solved. What was broken, how did you find the cause, and how did you fix it?



2. Which of the following have you personally used? Rate yourself from 1–5 for each: GoHighLevel (builds, workflows, CRM, break-fix), Meta Conversions API, Google Tag Manager, GA4, WhatConverts, Zapier, AgencyAnalytics, Google Merchant Center, Claude or other AI tools.



3. Describe a Meta Conversions API and/or Google Tag Manager setup you have built. What conversions were you tracking, and how did you test that they were firing correctly?



4. Have you used WhatConverts, Zapier, and AgencyAnalytics? For each one you've used, tell us what you set up or built.



5. How many hours per week are you currently working for other employers or clients? If hired, what hours would you be available for Murray Marketing Services?



6. Are you comfortable using TimeProof time tracking?

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Are you the person everyone calls when things get messy?



You know the type. The one who turns a pile of random files into folders that actually make sense. The one who remembers the deadline everyone else forgot. The one who quietly writes the "how to" guide so nobody has to ask the same question twice.



If that's you, we'd love to meet you. Ascend Growth Agency is hiring a part-time Virtual Assistant to help our owner get organized and get more done.



The short version:

 - $750 USD per month, paid by Wise on the 5th and 20th + Eligible for 13th month salary after 6 months

 - 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday

 - US business hours (Central Time), which is a night shift in the Philippines

 - 10 paid days off your first year, growing to 20 the longer you stay

 - Long-term, with the ability to go full time.

- Who You'll Be Working With



Ascend Growth Agency is a US digital marketing agency with a team of 5. We help local businesses and agency partners with websites, graphic design, local SEO, CRM updates, funnels, and AI agent setups. Our clients count on us for fast, reliable work every week.



You'll work directly with the owner. He wears a lot of hats (honestly, too many), and he's ready to hand some of them to someone he can trust. Here's how he puts it:



"We treat people the way we like to be treated. If you're looking for an environment where you are treated with respect and dignity, then this is the place for you."



Here's what that looks like in real life:

- You get paid on time, every time: the 5th and the 20th, by Wise

- Paid days off: 10 in year 1, 12 in years 2 and 3, 15 in years 4 and 5, and 20 from year 6 on

- Your shift is 4 hours. When it ends, you're done for the day.

- You'll be the one building the systems. If you see a better way, say so. That's part of the job.

- We reply to every applicant, even if it's a no. You won't be left waiting and wondering.



What Your Days Will Look Like



At first, you'll shadow the owner and learn how he works. Then, little by little, you'll take things off his plate and make them run smoother than before. You'll:

- Shadow the owner and write down the work he does that you can take over

- Create SOPs (step-by-step guides) for repeat tasks

- Keep the owner organized: tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups

- Organize and clean up file systems so anyone can find what they need

- Find ways to use systems, people, and AI to automate and delegate work

- Follow up with team members and make sure work gets done on time

- Learn our CRM and set up
 sequences that send our follow-ups automatically



In a few months, you'll look back and see a calmer, more organized business that runs better because of you. That's the kind of work you can be proud of.



Your Schedule



4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, during US business hours (Central Time). You'll work one of these two shifts. We'll pick the best one together during your interview.

- 8am to 12pm Central Time (10pm to 2am Philippine time, or 9pm to 1am from March to November)

- 1pm to 5pm Central Time (3am to 7am Philippine time, or 2am to 6am from March to November)



Yes, that's a night shift in the Philippines, so please make sure it works for you before you apply.



What You Bring

- 3+ years as a Virtual Assistant for a busy entrepreneur

- Strong written and spoken English

- Comfortable with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and Loom

- Available 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, during US business hours (Central Time)

- Reliable computer, webcam, headset, and fast internet, plus a backup plan if power or internet goes down (we know brownouts happen)

- A quiet place to work



You'll Fit Right In If You're...

- Organized, with an eye for detail

- A reliable communicator who gives updates without being asked

- Excited to learn new technology

- A team player

- Great at creating clear SOPs

- Great at organizing file systems

- Kind but firm. You can politely hold people accountable to getting their work done (yes, even the boss).

- Not afraid to use AI responsibly to work faster and smarter



Bonus Points For

- Experience with CRM systems

- Experience with project management systems

- Customer service experience

- Understanding of marketing

- Don't have all of these? That's OK. Apply anyway if you meet the must-haves.



Let's Be Honest: This Isn't for You If...

- You need step-by-step direction for every task

- You go quiet when you're stuck or running late (we'd much rather hear "I need help" early)

- You're not comfortable being on camera for meetings



Why You'll Love It Here

- A small team where you matter. With 5 of us, your systems will shape how the whole business runs.

- You'll keep learning. CRM automation, AI tools, and marketing systems, all on the job.



Our Hiring Steps



We keep it simple and respectful of your time:

- Fill out the application form (about 15 minutes)

- Zoom interview with our team

- Final interview with the owner

- Job offer and NDA (a privacy agreement)



Your first 60 days are a trial period, so we can both make sure it's a great fit.



How to Apply

- Fill out the application here: 
 

- Upload your resume on the form.

- Paste your Loom video links (3 minutes or less) on the form. Tell us:

  - About your experience as a Virtual Assistant for a busy entrepreneur

  - An SOP or system you created and how it helped

  - How you use AI tools in your work

- No fancy editing needed. We want to hear you, not a production.

- Then we’ll let you know next steps within 7 days.



Applications without the form, or the videos won't move forward. Little details matter in this role, and following instructions is your first chance to show us you've got this.



Salamat for reading all the way to the end. We can't wait to meet you!

title: Bookkeeper for Legal Practice
description:
JOB TITLE

Part-Time Bookkeeper – Australian Law Firm (Xero, Smokeball, Trust Accounting)



Type: Part-time, approx. 6 hours/week (flexible), long-term

Pay: $250 USD/month + 13th month pay

Schedule: Flexible, but you must check the billing inbox and bank feeds every Australian business day. Some overlap with Australian business hours is needed (Australia is 2–3 hours ahead of PHT).



THE ROLE IN SHORT

We are a small Australian legal practice looking for a reliable, detail-focused bookkeeper to take ownership of our day-to-day finances. Volume is low (about 2–5 bank transactions per day and 2–5 trust transactions per week), so accuracy and consistency matter more than speed.



Your four core responsibilities:

1. Reconcile our office accounts in Xero and our trust account in Smokeball

2. Run fortnightly payroll for one employee, including STP and superannuation

3. Manage our billing inbox and follow up unpaid client invoices

4. Keep our books BAS-ready for our registered BAS agent



MUST HAVE

- 2+ years of bookkeeping for Australian businesses using Xero

- Australian payroll experience: STP, superannuation, leave accruals

- Working knowledge of Australian GST and PAYG withholding

- Experience with Hubdoc

- Excellent written English (you will be
ing our clients)

- Reliable internet and a backup power/internet plan



STRONGLY PREFERRED

- Australian legal trust accounting experience

- Experience with Smokeball or another legal practice management system (e.g. LEAP, Actionstep)



------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Day-to-day bookkeeping (Xero)

- Code and reconcile bank feeds for our office bank accounts, credit cards and loans

- Process supplier invoices and receipts from Hubdoc into Xero

- Reconcile accounts payable and accounts receivable

- Reconcile the ATO Integrated Client Account

- Keep Smokeball in line with Xero (e.g. recording client payments against invoices). If you're not familiar with a legal practice management system, you'll provide a clear report so our staff can make the entries.



Billing inbox and collections

- Monitor the billing/accounts
 inbox, handle routine queries and pass on anything else

- Track overdue client invoices and follow up for payment. Your approach and any escalation will be agreed with the principal before you contact the client.



Trust account (monthly)

- Reconcile the trust account in Smokeball

- Review trust transactions and flag issues such as missing transactions, dormant balances and stale cheques

- Prepare the month-end trust report pack for the principal to review and sign



Payroll (fortnightly, one employee)

- Process the pay run in Xero and report through Single Touch Payroll (STP)

- Prepare superannuation payments in Xero each pay cycle for the principal to approve

- Process leave requests and keep leave balances accurate

- Reconcile wages payable, PAYG withholding and super payable

- Use Xero's employee onboarding for any new staff

- Help prepare end-of-financial-year STP finalisation



BAS (quarterly)

- Reconcile GST, PAYG withholding and the ATO Integrated Client Account so our BAS agent can review and lodge

- Provide the agent with the reports and information they need



Month-end

- Complete all bank reconciliations

- Prepare the monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet



Annual

- Prepare the trust records pack for our external examiner (trust cashbooks, registers of controlled money and investments, dormant balance and overdraw reports, trust bank statements)



Your first few weeks

- Review our Xero file (ATO Integrated Client Account, GST, PAYG withholding, super payable, wages payable, bank reconciliations) and our trust reconciliations to date, and flag anything that needs fixing



HOW WE WORK

- You prepare, and the principal approves and releases all payments. You will not be asked to move money.

- You'll work alongside our registered BAS agent, who reviews and lodges our BAS.

- As a law firm we handle confidential client information, so you'll sign a confidentiality agreement.

- Clear communication matters more than being online at fixed hours. Tell us early if something doesn't look right.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Long-term, stable role with a small team

- 13th month pay

- A manageable, well-defined workload that fits alongside other part-time work

- Room to grow hours as the practice grows



------------------------------------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that don't follow these steps won't be considered.



1. Start your message with the words "Office and Trust Bookkeeping"

2. Briefly describe your experience with:

   - Xero

   - Australian payroll (STP and super) and GST/BAS

   - Legal trust accounting, and which practice management system you've used

3. Answer these in a few sentences each:

   a. How do you reconcile a law firm trust account, and what do you do if it doesn't balance?

   b. Walk us through a fortnightly pay run in Xero, including STP and super.

   c. What is the ATO Integrated Client Account, and why reconcile it?

4. Confirm you're comfortable with $250 USD/month for approx. 6 hours/week

5. A screenshot of your internet speed test
