Team: Buyers Agency

Reports to: Chief Operations Officer, with a direct line to the Director on strategy

Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time (40 hours per week). Starts part-time (20 hours per week) during training and probation, then moves to full-time.

Working hours: Monday to Friday, within Melbourne business hours (AEST/AEDT), including the weekly Buyers Agency meeting (Tuesday, 1:00 PM Melbourne)

Start date: As soon as possible



About Charlie Property

Charlie Property is an Australian property investment business led by Director Charles Corby. We buy, renovate and hold residential property with our money partners, and our Buyers Agency helps clients buy the right property. Our team works remotely across Australia, the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia, in Leadership, Marketing, Renovations, Buyers Agency, Acquisitions, and Finance and Admin.

We celebrate differences. We value different points of view, open communication and respectful debate, because better ideas come from people who think differently. We use AI tools and clear systems every day so the whole team can work smarter.



About the Role

This role owns the Buyers Agency: its team, its client journey and its growth. The person leads a team of four across Australia, Vietnam and Indonesia, makes sure every client moves from first call to settlement without anything falling through the cracks, and sets the strategies that win more clients and better deals. Good work here means clear ownership, steady conversion, and a Director who knows exactly where the Buyers Agency stands each week. This is a non-transacting role: the manager leads and coordinates, and does not act as the buyer's agent for clients.





Key Responsibilities

- Team leadership: Lead the Buyers Agency customer Success and sales team members. Hold a 30-minute one-on-one with each team member every week, set clear weekly priorities, and give feedback early and kindly.

- Weekly Buyers Agency meeting: Run the weekly meeting (Tuesday, 1:00 PM Melbourne), and make sure every action has one owner and a due date in ClickUp.

- Role ownership: Within the first 30 days, agree and document who owns each step of the client journey across Sales and Customer Success, then keep it up to date.

- Client journey and pipeline: Review the GoHighLevel pipeline at least twice a week, chase stuck clients, and make sure every new client comes in through the application form so automations fire.

- Buyers Agency strategy: Lead the strategy for client acquisition, agent relationships and off-market deal flow, including the stale-listing agent outreach, and present one improvement or test to the Director each month.

- Cross-team coordination: Be the single point of contact for Acquisitions (lead referrals), Marketing (landing pages and deal proposals) and Finance (commitment fees, invoicing and income reporting).

- SOPs and systems: Keep Buyers Agency SOPs current and improve them as the team learns, including the AML SOP and the client expectation-setting step.

- Compliance: Work with leadership to keep the team within real estate licensing rules, and make sure client-facing work that needs a license goes to a licensed person.

- Weekly report: Send the Director a short update every Friday: pipeline by stage, clients signed, deals presented, settlements, blockers and decisions needed.





What Success Looks Like

- Client journey ownership - Ownership of each client journey step agreed and documented, and all carried-over Buyers Agency actions closed or re-planned with an owner, by day 30

- Weekly reporting - Weekly update sent to the OPS Team every week

- Pipeline conversion - Clients ready to sign moved to contract, conversion tracked by stage in GoHighLevel, and agent outreach running daily across NSW, VIC and QLD





Skills and Experience

Must have

- Based in the Philippines

- Several years working in or managing a buyers agency in Australia, and 3 or more years in Australian residential property

- 3 or more years leading or coordinating a team, ideally remote or cross-cultural

- Understands investing strategies such as buy-and-hold, renovation and flipping

- Has run a sales or client pipeline with targets

- Confident with CRM and project tools such as GoHighLevel, ClickUp and Google Workspace, and able to own and fix them

- Clear, warm and direct communication

- Available full-time in Melbourne business hours (part-time during training and probation)





Nice to have

- Real estate license or Cert IV in Real Estate Practice

- Experience running a property education course or program

- Experience with RP Data (CoreLogic) or similar

- Uses AI tools in daily work





Tools You Will Use

ClickUp (tasks and projects), Slack (team chat), Google Workspace 
, documents and meetings), Jibble (time tracking), Claude (AI assistant), GoHighLevel, RP Data (CoreLogic), Webflow (deal proposals, via Marketing).





How We Work

- Remote first: We work across time zones, so we write things down and keep our tasks updated in ClickUp.

- Daily rhythm: Clock in with Jibble, join the daily AI Hour and send your EOD report before you log off.

- Weekly check-ins: Join the weekly all-hands meeting and a weekly 1:1 with your manager.

- Learning: Team coaching sessions, AI training and the chance to build systems that make work easier.





What We Offer

- Remote, full-time role within Melbourne business hours

- A part-time start during training and probation, so you can learn our systems before moving to full-time

- A daily AI Hour to learn and use AI tools at work

- Team coaching sessions with an external coach

- $ 8 - 10 USD hourly rate



How to Apply

Send the following through the job post before the closing date:

- Your CV or resume

- A short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself and telling us why you want this role

- Your answer to this question: Tell us about a time you took over a property or sales team where ownership was unclear and actions were slipping. What did you change first, and what happened?





Our hiring process

1. Application and video review

2. Interview with the Chief Operations Officer and Director

3. Paid trial task

4. Offer and onboarding

title: Senior Amazon Marketplace Manager (Philippines)
description:
Senior Amazon Marketplace Manager (Philippines)



Salary: USD 8.65 to 14.40 per hour, depending on experience (about USD 1,500 to 2,500 per month, full-time)

Hours: PH 13:00 to 22:00, Monday to Friday, all year. In the Netherlands that is 07:00 to 16:00 in summer time (end of March to end of October) and 06:00 to 15:00 in winter time. An afternoon and evening shift, not a graveyard shift.

Type: full-time, remote, long term

Benefits: 13th month bonus (pro rata), paid in the first week of December. HMO allowance of up to $75 per month, starting 4 months after your start date.



ABOUT VIBRIX

Vibrix is a Dutch brand for a healthy indoor climate. Our founder, Remco Lunshof, suffered from allergies and asthma for years. He tested air purifiers from the big brands, was not convinced, and in 2019 started Vibrix in Rijswijk (Netherlands) with one air purifier of his own. Johnny Ma joined as co-owner in 2023 and leads product development.



Today we sell air purifiers (PureFlow), dehumidifiers (DryFlow) and replacement filters to thousands of households through our own webshop, Bol and Amazon. We test every model ourselves before it goes on sale, customers get an answer from a real person every day, and we are rated 4.6 out of 5 on Trustpilot from more than 3,200 reviews. Our products are made by partner factories in China, and we now receive full 40HQ containers every month.



Our mission: healthy air in every home, in every season. We want to grow from the Netherlands and Belgium to more European countries, and over the next 12 to 18 months we are building a team of experienced people, most of them in the Philippines.



See who we are on our website: vibrix . nl (type it without the spaces)



You will work directly with the owners, Remco and Johnny, and with our new Team Lead.



THE ROLE

You own our Amazon accounts in Europe, starting with Amazon Netherlands and Germany. You keep the accounts healthy, run PPC and make sure the full catalog is live.



Your first project is account health: getting our European accounts in good standing and keeping them there.



After a year, success looks like this:

• The full catalog is live on Amazon Netherlands and Germany.

• PPC in Germany runs profitably (TACOS below break-even).

• We are live in France through FBA.



WHAT WE ASK

• At least 3 years of proven experience in this role, at a B2C e-commerce brand in consumer electronics or home appliances with USD 5 to 20M yearly revenue. That is the revenue of your employer itself, not of a client or a parent company. Tell us the brand and its yearly revenue, with currency.

• Experience only at large corporations, Amazon aggregators, companies with many brands or B2B companies is not what we are looking for. What counts is experience at one brand that sells electrical appliances or consumer electronics online to consumers, for example air purifiers, heaters, fans, kitchen or personal care appliances.

• At least 3 years of experience managing Amazon seller accounts.

• You have run Amazon PPC (Sponsored Products) campaigns yourself.

• You have solved an Amazon account health problem yourself, for example a suspended listing or an at-risk account.

• In-house or agency experience, not only freelance or task-based work.

• This is your only job.

• Certificate of Employment from your last two employers. We check your years of experience with it.

• At least 15 Mbps download speed, measured on the computer and at the place you will work from. The form asks for the link to your speedtest.net result.

• A laptop with 8 GB RAM and a good headset.



Nice to have: experience with Amazon Europe (for example Germany, the Netherlands, France).



We are looking for someone who knows more than we do about Amazon. You learn fast, figure things out yourself and want to grow with the company.



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT

• Not a listing upload or data entry role.

• Not customer service.

• Not a graveyard shift.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Apply ONLY through our application form. Messages and applications through the OnlineJobs.ph system will not be read.

2. Form: type this in your browser without the spaces: docs . google . com / forms / d / e / 1FAIpQLSdzzVAFHei0PLDwmGstGocCmUxSLnD-ncEvFyW5Umqfj8Q_7A / viewform

3. When applying, use 10 Apply Points.

4. Code word: storefront. You need it to complete the form, so read the full post.

title: YouTube Video Editor + Motion Graphics (work with a 1M+ sub creator & channel)
description:
WHO WE ARE



Compound One Studios makes long-form YouTube videos for different finance and investing channels. We are the team behind New Money, one of the biggest investing channels on YouTube with over 1 million subscribers. Our work is taking a complicated money topic and making it clear and easy to watch.



THE JOB



We're hiring one full-time YouTube editor who can make good motion graphics to own videos from first cut to final export. That's around 6+ long-form videos a month, usually 10 to 25 minutes each.



You'll:



- Shape raw footage into a video people want to keep watching: the hook, the pacing, the story.

- Work out what should be on screen so a complicated money idea becomes easy to understand.

- Build charts, numbers and explainer animations, using motion graphics you build, as well as some of our templates. We don't mind if you use AI tools too, as long as the quality is high, we don't mind how we get the best results.

- Check that every number on screen is right, and speak up when something doesn't add up.

- Finish sound, colour and export to our checklists.



WHAT YOU NEED



- At least 2 years editing long-form YouTube videos (8+ minutes) for clients.

- Premiere Pro and After Effects or similar.

- Examples of graphics you made that explain something, not just templated animations that decorate the screen.

- Good YouTube retention instincts. You know why someone keeps watching and why they leave.

- Clear written and spoken English.

- Great attention to detail.

- A computer with 16 GB+ of RAM and a dedicated graphics card, plus reliable internet.

- An ability to tell us early, and communicate well if you are likely to miss a deadline or something is going to slip.



You don't need a finance background but a basic understanding of investing concepts is a big bonus. We can teach you. Curiosity and care with numbers matter more.



THE HARD PARTS



- We give a lot of detailed feedback, and every video goes through a checklist.

- Our videos are graphics heavy and the standard is high.

- This is an exclusive, full-time role of 40 hours a week. Sydney is 3 hours ahead of Manila, and we need a few hours of overlap each day with Sydney business hours.



WHAT YOU GET



- PHP 54,000 to 96,000 a month as an independent contractor. Where you start depends on the quality of your work.

- One team and steady monthly pay, instead of chasing clients.

- Regular feedback from the people behind New Money.

- Room to move up and grow (in role and in salary) as you prove yourself.

- A world-class education in how to make high-quality YouTube content working directly with one of the top creators in finance and investing.



HOW TO APPLY



Please apply through this form only. It takes about 5 minutes, and you don't need a CV or cover letter: 



Messages sent without the form won't be read. Individuals only, no agencies.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. A short unpaid edit, a few hours.

2. A paid sample, about one working day.

3. A Google Meet call or interview.

4. A real paid project on a real client video working alongside our actual team.

5. An offer.



We review applications multiple times per week.

title: OPERATIONS MANAGER (REAL ESTATE EXP IS A MUST!)
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly efficient Operations Manager to serve as the operational backbone of our growing organization. Because we rely heavily on AI to multiply our output, this is not a traditional middle-management position—we need a generalist leader with broad operational capability who can build systems, execute AI-driven projects, organize complex data, and lead a team of Virtual Assistants (VAs).



You will own the mechanics of how our business runs: from architecting our lead funnel and customer-touch processes to troubleshooting daily bottlenecks and coaching our team for maximum efficiency.



Key Responsibilities



AI Leverage & Project Execution: Identify high-impact opportunities to integrate AI tools and automation into daily workflows. Take AI initiatives from concept to full operational deployment, ensuring tools actually save time and improve output quality.



Funnel & Customer-Touch Architecture: Build, optimize, and maintain our end-to-end lead funnel. Design and document seamless customer-touch processes—from initial inquiry through onboarding and ongoing client communication—so nothing falls through the cracks.



VA Team Leadership & Coaching: Directly manage, mentor, and coach a team of Virtual Assistants. Drive coaching efficiency by creating clear SOPs, running tight feedback loops, and holding team members accountable to clear performance metrics.



Systems, Data & Operational Fixes: Maintain clean, structured, and accessible company data across our tech stack. Act as the primary problem-solver for operational breakdowns—stepping in to execute quick fixes while designing permanent system improvements to prevent repeat issues.



Qualifications



Proven Operational Range: Demonstrated experience in an Operations Manager, Chief of Staff, or senior integrator role where you wore multiple hats across systems, marketing operations, and client delivery.



High AI Fluency: Hands-on experience using modern AI tools (LLMs, workflow automation platforms like Zapier/Make, AI-assisted data tools) to streamline business operations—not just surface-level prompting.



Funnel & CRM Experience: Practical background building or managing lead pipelines, CRM workflows, and multi-channel customer touchpoints.



Remote Team Leadership: Track record of successfully managing and upskilling remote teams or Virtual Assistants, with a sharp eye for workflow efficiency and clear delegation.



Data & Systems Mindset: Strong organizational skills with the ability to audit messy processes, clean up databases, and build scalable, repeatable workflows.



Please include "Leverage Agent - Operations Manager" in the subject line.
